decisions.choice: listen: a call to hear with full attention
decisions.reason: The same verb opens Israel's creed, "Hear, O Israel" (Deuteronomy 6:4). Hearing is the theme of the whole parable (4:9, 23-24).

decisions.choice: to me
decisions.reason: Readable makes the call to the hearers plain.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} (L, B); {{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}} (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the crowd, so the command is plural and takes the ustedes / vosotros setting, as do the other plural commands of the chapter. In Readable, "me" is joined to the verb and takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: Écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} (R)
decisions.reason: The supplied "me" is Jesus speaking of himself, so in French it takes the deity_pronoun span like every other such pronoun.

source.text: ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων σπεῖραι.

records.literal_gloss: Behold, went out the [one] sowing to sow.

en.L: Look, the sower went out to sow.
en.B: A farmer went out to sow seed.
en.R: A farmer went out to plant some seed.

vi.L: Kìa, người gieo giống đi ra để gieo.
vi.B: Có một nông dân đi ra gieo giống.
vi.R: Có một người nông dân ra đồng gieo hạt.

ko.L: 보아라, 씨 뿌리는 사람이 씨를 뿌리러 나갔다.
ko.B: 씨 뿌리는 사람이 씨를 뿌리러 나갔다.
ko.R: 한 농부가 씨를 뿌리러 밭에 나갔다.

es.L: He aquí, salió el sembrador a sembrar.
es.B: Un campesino salió a sembrar.
es.R: Un campesino salió a sembrar semillas.

fr.L: Voici, le semeur sortit pour semer.
fr.B: Un semeur sortit pour semer.
fr.R: Un homme est sorti dans son champ pour semer des graines.

sw.L: Tazama, mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda.
sw.B: Mkulima mmoja alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu.
sw.R: Mkulima mmoja alikwenda shambani kupanda mbegu.

decisions.choice: behold: look, pay attention
decisions.reason: The word draws attention to what follows.

decisions.choice: the sower: a farmer scattering seed by hand
decisions.reason: Seed was thrown by the handful from a bag as the farmer walked over the field, so some fell where it could not grow.

decisions.choice: a farmer
decisions.reason: "Sower" is an old word. Balanced and Readable name him as a farmer; the article marks a typical case, not a known man.

decisions.choice: not translated (B, R)
decisions.reason: In Balanced and Readable the story's opening words already call for attention.

decisions.choice: "씨 뿌리는 사람" (L, B); "농부" (R)
alternatives: "농부" at Balanced as in the English
decisions.reason: "씨 뿌리는 사람" is the ordinary Korean way to name someone sowing and keeps the link with 4:14 ("씨 뿌리는 사람은 말씀을 뿌린다"); Readable says "농부" (farmer).

decisions.choice: un campesino
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable name the man as a farmer scattering seed by hand (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps "el sembrador".

decisions.choice: not translated (B, R); he aquí (L)
decisions.reason: As in English, Balanced and Readable leave the call to attention to the "Escuchen" that comes just before. Literal keeps "he aquí", as in 3:34.

decisions.choice: le semeur (L); un semeur (B); un homme ... dans son champ (R)
decisions.reason: "Semeur" is the plain French word for a man sowing by hand (meaning decision m2), and it ties the parable to its explanation in 4:14, "le semeur sème la parole". Readable describes the scene in everyday words.

decisions.choice: Voici (L); not translated (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English, Balanced and Readable leave out the attention-getter, which "Écoutez !" already does in French.

decisions.choice: mpanzi (sower) at Literal; mkulima (farmer) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: "Mpanzi" is the one who sows, as the Greek says; Balanced and Readable say "mkulima" (farmer), the everyday word, as the English says "a farmer". The same in 4:14.

source.text: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ σπείρειν ὃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ ἦλθεν τὰ πετεινὰ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτό.

records.literal_gloss: And it came about in the sowing, some fell along the road, and came the birds and devoured it.

en.L: And it happened as he sowed [that] some fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
en.B: As he scattered it, some seed fell beside the path, and birds came and ate it up.
en.R: As he threw the seed, some of it landed on the path. Birds came and ate it.

vi.L: Và xảy ra trong khi gieo, có [hạt] rơi dọc theo lối đi, và chim chóc đến ăn nuốt hết.
vi.B: Trong khi người ấy rải hạt, có một số hạt rơi bên lối đi, và chim đến ăn mất.
vi.R: Khi người ấy rải hạt, có một số hạt rơi trên lối đi. Chim bay đến ăn hết.

ko.L: 그런데 씨를 뿌리는 동안에 어떤 것은 길가에 떨어졌고, 새들이 와서 그것을 먹어 버렸다.
ko.B: 그가 씨를 뿌리는데, 어떤 씨는 길가에 떨어져서 새들이 와서 먹어 버렸다.
ko.R: 농부가 씨를 뿌릴 때, 어떤 씨는 길 위에 떨어졌다. 그러자 새들이 와서 그 씨를 먹어 버렸다.

es.L: Y sucedió que, al sembrar, una parte cayó junto al camino, y vinieron las aves y se la comieron.
es.B: Mientras esparcía la semilla, una parte cayó junto al camino, y vinieron los pájaros y se la comieron.
es.R: Mientras echaba la semilla, una parte cayó en el camino. Vinieron los pájaros y se la comieron.

fr.L: Et il arriva, pendant qu’il semait, qu’une partie tomba le long du chemin, et les oiseaux vinrent et la dévorèrent.
fr.B: Comme il semait, une partie des graines tomba au bord du chemin ; les oiseaux vinrent et la mangèrent.
fr.R: Pendant qu’il lançait les graines, une partie est tombée sur le chemin. Des oiseaux sont venus et les ont mangées.

sw.L: Ikawa alipokuwa akipanda, mbegu nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, na ndege wakaja wakazila.
sw.B: Alipokuwa akizitawanya, mbegu nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, na ndege wakaja wakazila zote.
sw.R: Alipokuwa akizirusha mbegu, nyingine zilianguka njiani. Ndege wakaja wakazila.

decisions.choice: the path: a trodden way through or beside the field
decisions.reason: Paths ran through fields and were beaten hard by feet. Seed lay on top where birds could see it.

decisions.choice: it came about: a way of starting a new event in a story
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the style of Hebrew storytelling and adds no meaning of its own.

decisions.choice: path
decisions.reason: The word is the usual one for a road, but here it is a footpath beside a field.

decisions.choice: camino
decisions.reason: The word is kept at every level because Jesus takes it up again in 4:15.

decisions.choice: une partie ... une autre [partie] ... d’autres (L); une partie des graines, d’autres graines (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of "some" and "other" in the singular and then, in 4:8, "others" in the plural. French "une partie" says a share of the seed thrown; Literal keeps the singular and then the plural, Balanced and Readable name the seeds.

source.text: καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸ πετρῶδες ὅπου οὐκ εἶχεν γῆν πολλήν, καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξανέτειλεν διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν βάθος γῆς·

records.literal_gloss: And other fell upon the rocky [ground] where not it had soil much, and immediately it sprang up because of not having depth of soil;

en.L: And other [seed] fell on the rocky ground, where it did not have much soil, and immediately it sprang up because it had no depth of soil;
en.B: Some fell on rocky ground, where there was little soil. It came up quickly, since the soil was shallow.
en.R: Some seed landed on rocky ground, where there was only a little dirt. The plants came up fast, because the dirt was not deep.

vi.L: Và [hạt] khác rơi trên nơi đất đá, là nơi không có nhiều đất, và lập tức mọc lên vì đất không sâu;
vi.B: Có hạt rơi trên nơi đất đá, chỉ có ít đất. Hạt ấy mọc lên nhanh vì lớp đất cạn.
vi.R: Có hạt rơi trên chỗ đất có nhiều đá, ở đó chỉ có một chút đất. Cây non mọc lên rất nhanh, vì đất không sâu.

ko.L: 또 다른 것은 흙이 많지 않은 돌밭에 떨어졌는데, 흙이 깊지 않아서 곧 싹이 돋았다.
ko.B: 어떤 씨는 흙이 얕은 돌밭에 떨어졌다. 흙이 깊지 않아서 싹이 금방 돋아났다.
ko.R: 어떤 씨는 돌이 많은 땅에 떨어졌다. 그곳에는 흙이 조금밖에 없었다. 흙이 깊지 않아서 싹이 빨리 나왔다.

es.L: Y otra cayó en el terreno pedregoso, donde no tenía mucha tierra, y enseguida brotó por no tener profundidad de tierra;
es.B: Otra parte cayó en terreno pedregoso, donde había poca tierra. Brotó pronto, porque la tierra no era profunda.
es.R: Otra parte cayó en un terreno lleno de piedras, donde había muy poca tierra. Las plantas salieron rápido, porque la tierra no era honda.

fr.L: Et une autre [partie] tomba sur le sol pierreux, où elle n’avait pas beaucoup de terre, et aussitôt elle leva, parce qu’elle n’avait pas de profondeur de terre ;
fr.B: Une autre partie tomba sur un sol pierreux, où il y avait peu de terre. Elle leva aussitôt, parce que la terre n’était pas profonde.
fr.R: D’autres graines sont tombées sur un sol plein de pierres, où il y avait juste un peu de terre. Les plantes ont poussé très vite, parce que la terre n’était pas profonde.

sw.L: Na nyingine zilianguka penye mawe, ambapo hapakuwa na udongo mwingi; na mara zikaota kwa sababu udongo haukuwa na kina;
sw.B: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mawe, ambako udongo ulikuwa kidogo. Zikaota upesi, kwa kuwa udongo haukuwa na kina.
sw.R: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mawe, ambako kulikuwa na udongo kidogo tu. Mimea ikaota haraka, kwa sababu udongo haukuwa na kina.

decisions.choice: rocky ground: a thin layer of soil over rock
decisions.reason: In Galilee a shallow layer of soil often lies over limestone. The farmer would not see the rock beneath.

decisions.choice: because it had no depth of soil: the shallow soil made it sprout fast
alternatives: it sprang up in spite of the shallow soil
decisions.reason: With no room to send roots down, the seed spent its strength in quick growth above ground.

decisions.choice: quickly (B); fast (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable vary the word for "immediately", as in chapters 1-3.

decisions.choice: "돌밭" (L, B); "돌이 많은 땅" (R)
decisions.reason: Rocky ground is a thin layer of soil over rock (meaning decision); "돌밭" is the everyday word, "돌짝밭" the older one of familiar versions.

decisions.choice: enseguida (L); pronto (B); rápido (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Mark's "enseguida" as in 1:10; here the word describes how fast the seed sprouted, so Balanced and Readable say it as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ὅτε ἀνέτειλεν ὁ ἥλιος ἐκαυματίσθη καὶ διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ῥίζαν ἐξηράνθη.

records.literal_gloss: and when rose the sun it was scorched, and because of not having root it withered.

en.L: and when the sun rose it was scorched, and because it had no root it withered away.
en.B: But when the sun came up, the young plants were scorched, and having no root they dried up.
en.R: But when the sun came up, it burned the young plants. They dried up and died, because they did not have deep roots.

vi.L: và khi mặt trời mọc, nó bị cháy nắng, và vì không có rễ nên khô héo đi.
vi.B: Nhưng khi mặt trời lên, các cây non bị cháy nắng, và vì không có rễ nên chúng khô héo.
vi.R: Nhưng khi mặt trời lên, nắng làm cháy các cây non. Chúng khô héo và chết, vì không có rễ sâu.

ko.L: 그리고 해가 떠오르자 그것은 볕에 타 버렸고, 뿌리가 없어서 말라 버렸다.
ko.B: 그러나 해가 뜨자 싹이 볕에 타고, 뿌리가 없어서 말라 버렸다.
ko.R: 그런데 해가 뜨자 뜨거운 햇볕에 어린 싹들이 타 버렸다. 뿌리가 깊지 않아서 말라 죽고 말았다.

es.L: y cuando salió el sol, se quemó, y por no tener raíz se secó.
es.B: Pero cuando salió el sol, las plantas tiernas se quemaron y, como no tenían raíz, se secaron.
es.R: Pero cuando salió el sol, quemó las plantas tiernas. Se secaron y murieron, porque no tenían raíces profundas.

fr.L: et quand le soleil se leva, elle fut brûlée, et, parce qu’elle n’avait pas de racine, elle se dessécha.
fr.B: Mais quand le soleil se leva, les jeunes pousses furent brûlées, et comme elles n’avaient pas de racine, elles séchèrent.
fr.R: Mais quand le soleil s’est levé, il a brûlé les jeunes plantes. Elles ont séché et elles sont mortes, parce qu’elles n’avaient pas de racines profondes.

sw.L: na jua lilipochomoza zikaungua, na kwa sababu hazikuwa na mizizi zikanyauka.
sw.B: Lakini jua lilipochomoza, mimea michanga iliungua, na kwa kuwa haikuwa na mizizi ikakauka.
sw.R: Lakini jua lilipochomoza, liliiunguza mimea michanga. Ikakauka na kufa, kwa sababu haikuwa na mizizi mirefu.

decisions.choice: not having root: no root that could reach water
decisions.reason: The plant had some root, but the rock stopped it from going deep (4:5).

decisions.choice: withered: dried up and died
decisions.reason: The verb means to dry out, as of a plant that dies.

decisions.choice: the young plants
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what the seed has become.

decisions.choice: las plantas tiernas
decisions.reason: As in English: says what was scorched, the young plants from the seed.

source.text: καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας, καὶ ἀνέβησαν αἱ ἄκανθαι καὶ συνέπνιξαν αὐτό, καὶ καρπὸν οὐκ ἔδωκεν.

records.literal_gloss: And other fell into the thorns, and came up the thorns and choked it, and fruit not it gave.

en.L: And other [seed] fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it did not give fruit.
en.B: Other seed fell among thorny weeds, which grew up and choked it, so that it produced no grain.
en.R: Some seed landed among thorny weeds. The weeds grew up and crowded out the young plants, so they did not produce any grain.

vi.L: Và [hạt] khác rơi vào giữa bụi gai, và gai mọc lên làm nghẹt nó, và nó không sinh trái.
vi.B: Có hạt khác rơi vào giữa bụi gai; gai mọc lên làm nghẹt nó, nên nó không ra hạt.
vi.R: Có hạt rơi giữa đám cỏ gai. Cỏ gai mọc lên, chèn ép các cây non, nên chúng không ra hạt nào.

ko.L: 또 다른 것은 가시덤불 속에 떨어졌는데, 가시덤불이 자라 올라 그것을 숨 막히게 하여, 그것이 열매를 맺지 못했다.
ko.B: 어떤 씨는 가시덤불 속에 떨어졌다. 가시덤불이 자라서 싹을 짓눌러 버렸으므로, 그 씨는 열매를 맺지 못했다.
ko.R: 어떤 씨는 가시덤불 사이에 떨어졌다. 가시덤불이 자라서 어린 싹들을 덮어 버렸다. 그래서 그 싹들은 곡식을 내지 못했다.

es.L: Y otra cayó entre los espinos, y los espinos crecieron y la ahogaron, y no dio fruto.
es.B: Otra parte cayó entre espinos, que crecieron y la ahogaron, de modo que no dio grano.
es.R: Otra parte cayó entre hierbas con espinas. Esas hierbas crecieron y ahogaron las plantas, así que no dieron grano.

fr.L: Et une autre [partie] tomba parmi les épines, et les épines montèrent et l’étouffèrent, et elle ne donna pas de fruit.
fr.B: Une autre partie tomba parmi les ronces, qui grandirent et l’étouffèrent, et elle ne produisit pas de grain.
fr.R: D’autres graines sont tombées au milieu des mauvaises herbes pleines d’épines. Les mauvaises herbes ont grandi et elles ont étouffé les jeunes plantes. Alors ces plantes n’ont pas donné de grain.

sw.L: Na nyingine zilianguka kati ya miiba, na miiba ikamea ikazisonga, wala hazikutoa matunda.
sw.B: Nyingine zilianguka kati ya magugu ya miiba, nayo yakakua yakazisonga, zisitoe nafaka.
sw.R: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kati ya magugu yenye miiba. Magugu hayo yakakua, yakaisonga mimea michanga, nayo haikutoa nafaka yoyote.

decisions.choice: thorns: thistles and weeds whose roots were already in the soil
decisions.reason: The ground looked clear when it was sown, but the weeds came up with the grain and were stronger.

decisions.choice: fruit: the crop, the grain
decisions.reason: For grain, "fruit" means the harvest it yields.

decisions.choice: grain
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the kind of crop.

decisions.choice: "열매" (L, B); "곡식" (R) for karpos in the parable (4:7-8)
decisions.reason: Korean "열매를 맺다" is said of any crop, and keeps the word Jesus uses again of people in 4:20; Readable names the crop plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: grano
decisions.reason: As in English: the fruit of grain is its crop (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps "fruto".

decisions.choice: les épines (L); les ronces (B); des mauvaises herbes pleines d’épines (R)
decisions.reason: The thorns are thistles and weeds already rooted in the soil (meaning decision m1). "Ronces" is the everyday French word for thorny plants that grow up and smother; Readable describes them.

source.text: καὶ ἄλλα ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν καλήν, καὶ ἐδίδου καρπὸν ἀναβαίνοντα καὶ αὐξανόμενα, καὶ ἔφερεν ἓν τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑκατόν.

records.literal_gloss: And others fell into the soil the good, and were giving fruit growing up and increasing, and were bearing one thirty and one sixty and one a hundred.

en.L: And other [seeds] fell into the good soil, and they gave fruit, growing up and increasing, and they bore thirtyfold and sixtyfold and a hundredfold."
en.B: But other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew, and produced a crop, yielding thirty, sixty, even a hundred times what was sown."
en.R: Other seed landed on good soil. The plants came up and grew strong, and they produced a big crop. Some plants made thirty times as much grain as was planted. Some made sixty times as much, and some made a hundred times as much."

vi.L: Và những [hạt] khác rơi vào đất tốt, và sinh trái, mọc lên và lớn lên, và kết quả, hạt thì ba mươi, hạt thì sáu mươi, hạt thì một trăm."
vi.B: Nhưng có những hạt khác rơi vào đất tốt. Chúng mọc lên, lớn lên và sinh hoa lợi, gấp ba mươi, gấp sáu mươi, có khi gấp một trăm lần số hạt đã gieo."
vi.R: Có những hạt khác rơi vào đất tốt. Cây mọc lên, lớn mạnh và cho một vụ mùa lớn. Có cây cho gấp ba mươi lần số hạt đã gieo, có cây gấp sáu mươi lần, có cây gấp một trăm lần."

ko.L: 또 다른 것들은 좋은 땅에 떨어졌다. 그리고 자라 올라 불어나면서 열매를 맺었고, 어떤 것은 서른 배, 어떤 것은 예순 배, 어떤 것은 백 배를 냈다."
ko.B: 그러나 어떤 씨는 좋은 땅에 떨어졌다. 그 씨는 싹이 나고 자라서 열매를 맺었는데, 뿌린 것의 서른 배나 예순 배, 많게는 백 배를 냈다."
ko.R: 또 어떤 씨는 좋은 땅에 떨어졌다. 그 씨는 싹이 나서 튼튼하게 자랐고, 곡식을 많이 냈다. 어떤 것은 뿌린 것보다 서른 배를 냈고, 어떤 것은 예순 배, 어떤 것은 백 배를 냈다."

es.L: Y otras cayeron en la tierra buena, y daban fruto, brotando y creciendo, y producían a treinta, y a sesenta, y a ciento por uno».
es.B: Pero otra parte cayó en tierra buena. Brotó, creció y dio una cosecha que rindió treinta, sesenta y hasta cien veces lo sembrado».
es.R: Otra parte cayó en tierra buena. Las plantas salieron y crecieron fuertes, y dieron una gran cosecha. Algunas dieron treinta veces más grano del que se sembró. Otras dieron sesenta veces más, y otras cien veces más».

fr.L: Et d’autres [grains] tombèrent dans la bonne terre, et ils donnaient du fruit, montant et croissant, et ils rapportaient l’un trente, l’un soixante, l’un cent. »
fr.B: D’autres graines tombèrent dans la bonne terre. Elles levèrent, grandirent et donnèrent du fruit, rapportant trente, soixante, et même cent fois ce qui avait été semé. »
fr.R: D’autres graines sont tombées dans la bonne terre. Les plantes ont poussé, elles sont devenues fortes, et elles ont donné une belle récolte. Certaines plantes ont produit trente fois plus de grain que ce qu’on avait semé, d’autres soixante fois plus, et d’autres cent fois plus. »

sw.L: Na nyingine zilianguka katika udongo mzuri, zikatoa matunda, zikimea na kukua, zikazaa: moja thelathini, na moja sitini, na moja mia."
sw.B: Lakini mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri. Zikaota, zikakua, zikatoa mazao: mara thelathini, mara sitini, hata mara mia ya kile kilichopandwa."
sw.R: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri. Mimea ikaota, ikakua vizuri, ikatoa mavuno mengi. Mimea mingine ilitoa nafaka mara thelathini ya mbegu iliyopandwa, mingine mara sitini, na mingine mara mia."

decisions.choice: one thirty, one sixty, one a hundred: each seed's yield
alternatives: in thirty, in sixty, in a hundred
decisions.reason: Early manuscripts had no accents, and the same letters can be read as "one" or "in". The SBLGNT reads "one". The sense is the same either way. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: others: plural, many seeds
decisions.reason: The earlier seed is singular; here the Greek turns to the plural, many seeds in good soil.

decisions.choice: a hundredfold: an amazing harvest
decisions.reason: Isaac reaped a hundredfold when God blessed him (Genesis 26:12). Even thirtyfold would be a very good crop.

decisions.choice: times what was sown (B); times as much grain as was planted (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the numbers measure.

decisions.choice: "hạt thì ba mươi, hạt thì sáu mươi, hạt thì một trăm"
alternatives: "gấp ba mươi, gấp sáu mươi, gấp một trăm"
decisions.reason: The Greek says "one thirty, one sixty, one a hundred", each seed's yield (the meaning decision). The Vietnamese pattern "hạt thì ..., hạt thì ..." says exactly that and keeps the Greek's repeated "one"; Balanced and Readable say "gấp ... lần" (times).

decisions.choice: a treinta, y a sesenta, y a ciento por uno
alternatives: uno a treinta, otro a sesenta
decisions.reason: Spanish says "ciento por uno" for a yield, which keeps the Greek "one" without deciding between the readings of meaning decision m1.

decisions.choice: veces lo sembrado (B); veces más grano del que se sembró (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: says what the numbers count.

decisions.choice: l’un trente, l’un soixante, l’un cent (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the repeated "one" of the Greek, read as each seed’s yield (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say it as a multiple of what was sown, as the English does.

decisions.choice: matunda (L); mazao (B); mavuno, nafaka (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek "fruit" here is the crop, the grain (4:7, 4:8, 4:20, 4:28). Literal keeps "matunda" (fruit), which Swahili also uses for the result of a life; Balanced says "mazao" (crop) and Readable "mavuno" (harvest) or "nafaka" (grain), so readers do not picture fruit on a tree.

source.text: καὶ ἔλεγεν· Ὃς ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying, Who has ears to hear let him hear.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying, "Whoever has ears to hear, let {{gender:them|him}} hear."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Anyone who has ears to hear should listen."
en.R: Then Jesus said, "If you have ears, then listen!"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Ai có tai để nghe, hãy nghe."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Ai có tai để nghe thì hãy lắng nghe."
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói: "Ai có tai thì hãy nghe cho kỹ!"

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 말씀하셨다. "들을 귀가 있는 사람은 들어라."
ko.B: 그리고 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "들을 귀가 있는 사람은 잘 들어라."
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "귀가 있으면 잘 들어라!"

es.L: Y decía: «El que tiene oídos para oír, que oiga».
es.B: Luego dijo: «Quien tenga oídos para oír, que escuche».
es.R: Luego Jesús dijo: «Si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} oídos, ¡{{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}!».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait : « Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende. »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre, qu’il écoute ! »
fr.R: Puis Jésus a dit : « Si vous avez des oreilles, alors écoutez ! »

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akisema, "Yeyote aliye na masikio ya kusikia, na asikie."
sw.B: Kisha akasema, "Mtu yeyote mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikilize."
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akasema, "Kama una masikio, basi sikiliza!"

decisions.choice: has ears to hear: is able and willing to take this in
decisions.reason: Everyone has ears; the saying calls hearers to think about what they heard and take it to heart.

decisions.choice: them (default), him (alternative)
decisions.reason: The saying is for everyone, men and women alike.

decisions.choice: If you have ears, then listen!
alternatives: whoever has ears to hear, let him hear
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the hearer directly.

decisions.choice: "ai" with no gender span (also 4:23, 4:25)
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: "Ai" (whoever) and "người ấy" are already inclusive, so the English gender spans have no Vietnamese counterpart (style guide section 7). Readable keeps "ai" where the English Readable says "you", since the generic form is the natural one in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span (also 4:23 and 4:25)
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" and "누구든지" already include men and women, and the command needs no pronoun, so the English gender span has nothing to change in Korean (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: que oiga / que escuche, no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "el que" and "quien" already include everyone, and the third-person command needs no pronoun, so the English gender span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: Si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} oídos, ¡{{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}!
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable speaks to the hearers directly; they are many, so the ustedes / vosotros setting applies.

decisions.choice: Que celui qui ... entende (L); Celui qui ..., qu’il écoute (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English Literal needs {{gender:them|him}}, French keeps "celui qui", which already means anyone, and the generic "il" that refers back to it; the French style guide adds no span there. The same holds for 4:23 and 4:25.

decisions.choice: no gender span (na asikie)
alternatives: a span as in the English (them|him)
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs "let them hear" with "him" as the traditional alternative. The Swahili verb "asikie" (let him or her hear) says nothing about sex, so there is nothing for the setting to change, here and in 4:23 and 4:25.

source.text: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο κατὰ μόνας, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν σὺν τοῖς δώδεκα τὰς παραβολάς.

records.literal_gloss: And when he was alone, were asking him those around him with the twelve [about] the parables.

en.L: And when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was alone, those around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with the twelve were asking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about the parables.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was by {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, the Twelve and the others around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about the parables.
en.R: Later Jesus was away from the crowd. The twelve apostles and some others who were with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about the stories.

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở riêng, những người ở quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cùng với mười hai [người] hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về các ngụ ngôn.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở riêng, nhóm Mười Hai và những người khác ở quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về các ngụ ngôn.
vi.R: Sau đó Đức Giê-xu rời khỏi đám đông. Mười hai sứ đồ và mấy người khác đang ở với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về các câu chuyện ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 홀로 계실 때에, 열둘과 함께 그분 둘레에 있던 사람들이 그 비유들에 대하여 그분께 묻고 있었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 따로 계실 때에, 열두 제자와 예수 둘레에 있던 사람들이 그 비유들에 대하여 여쭈었다.
ko.R: 나중에 예수께서 무리를 떠나 따로 계실 때, 열두 제자와 함께 있던 다른 사람들이 그 비유들이 무슨 뜻인지 예수께 여쭈었다.

es.L: Y cuando estuvo a solas, los que estaban alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con los doce {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaban sobre las parábolas.
es.B: Cuando se quedó a solas, los Doce y los demás que estaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron por las parábolas.
es.R: Más tarde, Jesús estaba lejos de la multitud. Los doce apóstoles y algunos otros que estaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hicieron preguntas sobre las historias.

fr.L: Et quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut seul, ceux qui étaient autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec les douze {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogeaient sur les paraboles.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut seul, les Douze et les autres qui étaient autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogèrent sur les paraboles.
fr.R: Plus tard, Jésus était loin de la foule. Les douze apôtres et quelques autres personnes qui étaient avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont posé des questions sur les histoires.

sw.L: Na alipokuwa peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, wale waliokuwa karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} pamoja na wale kumi na wawili walikuwa wakimwuliza kuhusu mifano ile.
sw.B: Alipokuwa peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, wale kumi na wawili na wengine waliokuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} walimwuliza kuhusu mifano hiyo.
sw.R: Baadaye Yesu alikuwa mbali na umati. Wale mitume kumi na wawili na watu wengine waliokuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} wakamwuliza maana ya mifano ile.

decisions.choice: those around him with the twelve: a wider group of followers as well as the twelve
decisions.reason: Mark names two groups. Those "around him" recall the people who sat around him in 3:34.

decisions.choice: alone: away from the crowd
decisions.reason: He is alone with his followers, not by himself.

decisions.choice: the parables: the SBLGNT has the plural
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts read the singular, or "what the parable was". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the Twelve (B); the twelve apostles (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "the Twelve" as the group's name; Readable says who they were (3:14). Literal keeps lowercase "the twelve".

decisions.choice: "nhóm Mười Hai" (B); "mười hai sứ đồ" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced names the group as a group, as the English "the Twelve" does; Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "열둘" (L); "열두 제자" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Mark's bare number; Balanced and Readable say who the Twelve are with the book's word for disciples, rather than the English Readable's "apostles".

decisions.choice: los Doce (B); los doce apóstoles (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced writes the group's name with a capital; Readable says who they were.

source.text: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑμῖν τὸ μυστήριον δέδοται τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ· ἐκείνοις δὲ τοῖς ἔξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὰ πάντα γίνεται, ἵνα βλέποντες βλέπωσι καὶ μὴ ἴδωσιν, καὶ ἀκούοντες ἀκούωσι καὶ μὴ συνιῶσιν, μήποτε ἐπιστρέψωσιν καὶ ἀφεθῇ αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying to them, To you the mystery has been given of the kingdom of the God; to those but the [ones] outside in parables the all things come about, \v 12 so that seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest they turn and it be forgiven them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying to them, "To you the mystery of the kingdom of God has been given, but to those outside everything comes in parables, \v 12 so that seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest they should turn and it be forgiven them."
en.B: He told them, "You have been given the mystery of the kingdom of God. But for those outside, everything comes in parables, \v 12 so that they may look and look but never perceive, and listen and listen but never understand; otherwise they might turn back and be forgiven."
en.R: Jesus told them, "God has given you the mystery of the kingdom of God. It is a secret that God is now making known to you. But people outside hear everything only in stories. \v 12 So they look and look, but they do not really see. They listen and listen, but they do not understand. Otherwise they might turn back to God and be forgiven."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sự mầu nhiệm của vương quốc Đức Chúa Trời đã được ban cho các con; nhưng với những người bên ngoài, mọi sự đều đến bằng ngụ ngôn, \v 12 để họ nhìn thì nhìn mà không thấy, nghe thì nghe mà không hiểu, kẻo họ quay lại và được tha thứ."
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Các con đã được ban cho sự mầu nhiệm của vương quốc Đức Chúa Trời. Nhưng với những người bên ngoài, mọi điều đều đến qua ngụ ngôn, \v 12 để họ nhìn đi nhìn lại mà không bao giờ thấy, nghe đi nghe lại mà không bao giờ hiểu; nếu không, họ đã quay trở lại và được tha thứ."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Đức Chúa Trời đã cho các con biết sự mầu nhiệm của vương quốc Đức Chúa Trời. Đó là điều bí mật mà bây giờ Đức Chúa Trời đang bày tỏ cho các con. Nhưng những người bên ngoài thì chỉ nghe mọi điều qua các câu chuyện. \v 12 Vì vậy, họ nhìn đi nhìn lại nhưng không thật sự thấy. Họ nghe đi nghe lại nhưng không hiểu. Nếu không như vậy, họ đã quay về với Đức Chúa Trời và được tha thứ."

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희에게는 하나님의 나라의 비밀이 주어졌다. 그러나 바깥에 있는 저 사람들에게는 모든 것이 비유로 된다. \v 12 그것은 그들이 보기는 보아도 알아보지 못하고, 듣기는 들어도 깨닫지 못하게 하려는 것이니, 그들이 돌이켜 용서받는 일이 없도록 하려는 것이다."
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희에게는 하나님의 나라의 비밀이 주어졌다. 그러나 바깥사람들에게는 모든 것이 비유로 주어진다. \v 12 그것은 그들이 보고 또 보아도 알아보지 못하고, 듣고 또 들어도 깨닫지 못하게 하려는 것이다. 그러지 않으면 그들이 돌이켜 용서를 받을지도 모른다."
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "하나님께서 너희에게 하나님의 나라의 비밀을 주셨다. 그것은 하나님께서 이제 너희에게 알려 주시는 숨겨진 뜻이다. 그러나 바깥에 있는 사람들은 모든 것을 비유로만 듣는다. \v 12 그래서 그들은 보고 또 보아도 제대로 보지 못하고, 듣고 또 들어도 깨닫지 못한다. 그러지 않으면 그들이 하나님께 돌아와서 용서를 받을지도 모른다."

es.L: Y les decía: «A {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado el misterio del reino de Dios; pero a los de afuera todo les llega en parábolas, \v 12 para que, viendo, vean y no perciban, y oyendo, oigan y no entiendan, no sea que se vuelvan y se les perdone».
es.B: Les dijo: «A {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado el misterio del reino de Dios. Pero a los de afuera todo les llega en parábolas, \v 12 para que miren y miren, pero no perciban; escuchen y escuchen, pero no entiendan; de otro modo, podrían volverse y ser perdonados».
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el misterio del reino de Dios. Es un secreto que Dios ahora {{plural_you:les|os}} está dando a conocer. Pero los de afuera lo oyen todo solo en historias. \v 12 Así que miran y miran, pero en realidad no ven. Escuchan y escuchan, pero no entienden. De otro modo, podrían volverse a Dios y ser perdonados».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « À vous a été donné le mystère du royaume de Dieu ; mais pour ceux du dehors, tout arrive en paraboles, \v 12 afin que, regardant, ils regardent et ne voient pas, et qu’entendant, ils entendent et ne comprennent pas, de peur qu’ils ne se retournent et qu’il ne leur soit pardonné. »
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Vous avez reçu le mystère du royaume de Dieu. Mais pour ceux du dehors, tout se présente en paraboles, \v 12 si bien qu’ils ont beau regarder, ils ne voient pas, et ils ont beau écouter, ils ne comprennent pas ; sinon, ils pourraient revenir et recevoir le pardon. »
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Dieu vous a donné le mystère du royaume de Dieu. C’est un secret que Dieu vous fait connaître maintenant. Mais les gens du dehors entendent tout seulement sous forme d’histoires. \v 12 Alors ils regardent et regardent, mais ils ne voient pas vraiment. Ils écoutent et écoutent, mais ils ne comprennent pas. Sinon, ils pourraient revenir vers Dieu et être pardonnés. »

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akiwaambia, "Ninyi mmepewa siri ya ufalme wa Mungu; lakini kwa wale walio nje, mambo yote huwa kwa mifano, \v 12 ili wakitazama watazame lakini wasione, na wakisikia wasikie lakini wasielewe, wasije wakageuka wakasamehewa."
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Ninyi mmepewa siri ya ufalme wa Mungu. Lakini kwa wale walio nje, kila kitu huja kwa mifano, \v 12 ili watazame na kutazama lakini wasitambue kamwe, na wasikilize na kusikiliza lakini wasielewe kamwe; la sivyo wangegeuka na kusamehewa."
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Mungu amewapa ninyi siri ya ufalme wa Mungu. Ni siri ambayo Mungu sasa anawafunulia ninyi. Lakini watu walio nje wanasikia kila kitu kwa mifano tu. \v 12 Kwa hiyo wanatazama na kutazama, lakini hawaoni kweli. Wanasikiliza na kusikiliza, lakini hawaelewi. La sivyo wangemgeukia Mungu na kusamehewa."

decisions.choice: mystery: God's secret plan, hidden until God makes it known
decisions.reason: In Daniel 2:28 God "reveals mysteries". The mystery is that God's kingdom is coming in Jesus. It is given, not worked out by cleverness.

decisions.choice: has been given: God has given it
decisions.reason: The passive leaves the giver unnamed; in Jewish speech this often points to God.

decisions.choice: those outside: people who do not come to Jesus to learn
decisions.reason: In 3:31-35 Jesus' own family stand outside, while those who sit around him are his family. Being outside is about response, not birth.

decisions.choice: seeing they may see ... lest they turn: Isaiah 6:9-10
decisions.reason: Jesus uses God's words to Isaiah, who was sent to a people who would not listen. The ending, "be forgiven", matches the ancient Aramaic paraphrase of Isaiah, where the Hebrew has "be healed".

decisions.choice: so that ... lest: Isaiah's words come true in those who refuse to hear
alternatives: so that: only a result, with no purpose
decisions.reason: "So that" usually states a purpose. In Isaiah, God's message hardens those who have already refused it. Some read the clause as a result, or read the last line as a hope that they might yet turn.

decisions.choice: It is a secret that God is now making known to you
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word "mystery" and adds what it means here.

decisions.choice: look and look, listen and listen
alternatives: seeing they may see, hearing they may hear
decisions.reason: The doubled verbs mean seeing again and again; Balanced and Readable repeat the verb to show this.

decisions.choice: turn back to God
decisions.reason: Readable says who they would turn to.

decisions.choice: "sự mầu nhiệm" for mystery
decisions.reason: "Sự mầu nhiệm" is the established word for God's plan once hidden and now made known; "huyền bí" suggests the occult. Readable adds "điều bí mật" to explain it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "kẻo" for "lest"
decisions.reason: "Kẻo" is the plain Vietnamese word for "lest", and like the Greek it leaves the purpose-or-result question to the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "các con" for the disciples and those with them
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to his followers as "các con", the form the style guide sets; the wider group in 4:10 is addressed with them.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라" and "비밀" at every level
decisions.reason: "하나님의 나라" is the form of the Korean John (3:3, 3:5), kept through Mark. "비밀" is a secret that is now told, which is the sense of the meaning decision; "신비" suggests something that stays beyond understanding.

decisions.choice: misterio
decisions.reason: "Misterio" is God's plan, hidden until God makes it known (meaning decision m1); Readable adds what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: miren y miren, escuchen y escuchen
decisions.reason: As in English: the doubled verbs show the Greek's "seeing they may see" in natural Spanish.

decisions.choice: se vuelvan (L); volverse (B); volverse a Dios (R)
decisions.reason: "Volverse" is turning around, as in Isaiah 6:10; "convertirse" would sound like church language. Readable says to whom, as the English does.

decisions.choice: le mystère du royaume de Dieu, at every level ("le royaume de Dieu" for the whole book)
decisions.reason: "Mystère" is God’s secret plan, now made known (meaning decision m1); Readable keeps the word and explains it, as the English Readable does. "Le royaume de Dieu" is the wording of the French letters (Colossians 4:11) and is kept wherever the phrase occurs.

decisions.choice: ils ont beau regarder ... ils ont beau écouter (B)
decisions.reason: French cannot double the verb as English "look and look" does without sounding clumsy in a public reading; "avoir beau" says the same thing: however much they look, they do not see. Literal keeps the Greek doubling, Readable the plain repetition.

decisions.choice: siri (secret) at every level
decisions.reason: The mystery is God's secret plan, hidden until God makes it known (m1). "Siri" says that; "fumbo" is a riddle to be solved, which would suggest the disciples worked it out for themselves rather than being given it.

source.text: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην, καὶ πῶς πάσας τὰς παραβολὰς γνώσεσθε;

records.literal_gloss: And he says to them, Not do you know the parable this, and how all the parables will you understand?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to them, "Do you not understand this parable? And how will you understand all the parables?
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Do you not see what this parable means? How then will you understand all the others?
en.R: Then Jesus said to them, "You do not understand this story? Then how will you understand any of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} stories?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các con không hiểu ngụ ngôn này sao? Vậy làm sao các con hiểu được tất cả các ngụ ngôn?
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các con không hiểu ngụ ngôn này sao? Thế thì làm sao các con hiểu được những ngụ ngôn khác?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Các con không hiểu câu chuyện này sao? Vậy thì làm sao các con hiểu được những câu chuyện khác của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하신다. "너희가 이 비유를 알지 못하느냐? 그러면 어떻게 모든 비유를 알겠느냐?
ko.B: 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희가 이 비유를 깨닫지 못하느냐? 그렇다면 다른 모든 비유는 어떻게 깨닫겠느냐?
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희가 이 비유도 알아듣지 못하느냐? 그러면 내 다른 비유들은 어떻게 알아듣겠느냐?

es.L: Y les dice: «¿No {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}} esta parábola? ¿Y cómo {{plural_you:entenderán|entenderéis}} todas las parábolas?
es.B: Luego les dijo: «¿No {{plural_you:ven|veis}} lo que significa esta parábola? ¿Cómo, entonces, {{plural_you:van|vais}} a entender todas las demás?
es.R: Luego Jesús les dijo: «¿No {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}} esta historia? Entonces, ¿cómo {{plural_you:van|vais}} a entender cualquiera de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} historias?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Vous ne comprenez pas cette parabole ? Et comment comprendrez-vous toutes les paraboles ?
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Vous ne saisissez pas le sens de cette parabole ? Comment comprendrez-vous alors toutes les autres ?
fr.R: Puis Jésus leur a dit : « Vous ne comprenez pas cette histoire ? Alors comment allez-vous comprendre toutes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} histoires ?

sw.L: Naye anawaambia, "Je, hamuujui mfano huu? Basi mtaielewaje mifano yote?
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Hamwelewi maana ya mfano huu? Basi mtaielewaje mifano mingine yote?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, "Hamwelewi mfano huu? Basi mtaielewaje mifano {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote?

decisions.choice: says: present tense telling a past event
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, Mark uses the present for vividness.

decisions.choice: this parable is the key to the others
alternatives: Jesus scolds them for being slow
decisions.reason: The parable of the sower is about hearing itself. Whoever misses it will miss the point of the rest.

decisions.choice: do you not understand: may be a question or a statement
alternatives: you do not understand this parable
decisions.reason: Either way, Jesus goes on to explain it.

decisions.choice: my stories
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear the parables are Jesus' own.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} historias
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says whose parables are meant.

decisions.choice: Vous ne comprenez pas ... ? (a statement with a question mark)
decisions.reason: The Greek may be a question or a statement (meaning decision m3). French spoken word order with a question mark leaves both readings open, where the inverted question would choose one.

source.text: ὁ σπείρων τὸν λόγον σπείρει.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] sowing the word sows.

en.L: The sower sows the word.
en.B: The farmer sows the word.
en.R: The farmer plants God's message in people.

vi.L: Người gieo giống gieo lời.
vi.B: Người nông dân gieo lời.
vi.R: Người nông dân gieo sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời vào lòng người ta.

ko.L: 씨 뿌리는 사람은 말씀을 뿌린다.
ko.B: 씨 뿌리는 사람이 뿌리는 것은 말씀이다.
ko.R: 농부는 사람들의 마음에 하나님의 말씀을 뿌린다.

es.L: El sembrador siembra la palabra.
es.B: El campesino siembra la palabra.
es.R: El campesino siembra en la gente el mensaje de Dios.

fr.L: Le semeur sème la parole.
fr.B: Le semeur sème la parole.
fr.R: Ce que le semeur sème, c’est le message de Dieu.

sw.L: Mpanzi hupanda neno.
sw.B: Mkulima hupanda neno.
sw.R: Mkulima anapanda ujumbe wa Mungu ndani ya watu.

decisions.choice: the word: the message of God's kingdom that Jesus preaches
decisions.reason: In Mark "the word" is the good news Jesus speaks (2:2; 4:33).

decisions.choice: the sower: not named
decisions.reason: The explanation is about the seed and the soils. The sower is anyone who spreads the word, first of all Jesus.

decisions.choice: God's message; in people
decisions.reason: Readable says whose word it is and where it is sown, which the next verses show.

decisions.choice: "lời" (L, B); "sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời" (R) for "the word" (whole chapter)
decisions.reason: Here the word is the message Jesus preaches, so it is written lowercase "lời", not "Ngôi Lời", John's title for the person. "Đạo" (the older Protestant word) now suggests a religion. Readable says what the word is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "말씀" (L, B); "하나님의 말씀" (R), through 4:14-20 and 4:33
decisions.reason: As in the Korean John, "말씀" is kept for God's word and Jesus's; here it is the message of God's kingdom (meaning decision). Readable names whose word it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: la palabra (L, B); el mensaje de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:2: "la palabra" is the message of God's kingdom (meaning decision m1); Readable says so. The same through 4:33.

decisions.choice: la parole (L, B), lowercase; le message de Dieu (R) (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: Here the word is the message of the kingdom that Jesus preaches (meaning decision m1), not the title of John 1, so it is "la parole" in lowercase, not "le Verbe". Readable says "le message de Dieu", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: neno (L, B); ujumbe wa Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "The word" is the message of God's kingdom that Jesus preaches (m1), so it is lowercase "neno", not the title "Neno" of John 1. Readable says "God's message", as the English Readable does, through 4:20 and in 4:33.

source.text: οὗτοι δέ εἰσιν οἱ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ὅπου σπείρεται ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν εὐθὺς ἔρχεται ὁ Σατανᾶς καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐσπαρμένον εἰς αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: These now are the [ones] along the road where is sown the word, and when they hear, immediately comes the Satan and takes away the word having been sown into them.

en.L: And these are the ones along the path where the word is sown: when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word that has been sown in them.
en.B: Some are like seed sown beside the path. When the word is sown in them and they hear it, Satan comes at once and carries off the word that was planted in them.
en.R: Some people are like the path where the seed fell. They hear God's message, but right away Satan comes. He takes away the message that was planted in them.

vi.L: Và đây là những người ở dọc lối đi, nơi lời được gieo: khi họ nghe, lập tức Sa-tan đến và cất đi lời đã được gieo trong họ.
vi.B: Có những người giống như hạt rơi bên lối đi. Khi lời được gieo vào họ và họ nghe, Sa-tan liền đến cướp mất lời đã gieo trong họ.
vi.R: Có những người giống như lối đi, nơi hạt giống rơi xuống. Họ nghe sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng Sa-tan đến ngay. Nó lấy đi sứ điệp đã được gieo trong họ.

ko.L: 그리고 말씀이 뿌려지는 길가의 사람들은 이런 사람들이다. 그들이 들으면 곧 사탄이 와서 그들 속에 뿌려진 말씀을 가져가 버린다.
ko.B: 어떤 사람들은 말씀이 길가에 뿌려진 것과 같다. 그들이 말씀을 들으면, 사탄이 곧바로 와서 그들 속에 뿌려진 말씀을 빼앗아 간다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 씨가 떨어진 길과 같다. 그들은 하나님의 말씀을 듣지만, 사탄이 바로 와서 그들 속에 뿌려진 말씀을 빼앗아 간다.

es.L: Y estos son los de junto al camino, donde se siembra la palabra: cuando oyen, enseguida viene Satanás y se lleva la palabra sembrada en ellos.
es.B: Algunos son como la semilla sembrada junto al camino. En cuanto la palabra se siembra en ellos y la oyen, Satanás viene enseguida y se lleva la palabra que fue sembrada en ellos.
es.R: Algunas personas son como el camino donde cayó la semilla. Oyen el mensaje de Dios, pero enseguida viene Satanás. Él se lleva el mensaje que fue sembrado en ellas.

fr.L: Et ceux-ci sont ceux qui sont le long du chemin, où la parole est semée : quand ils entendent, aussitôt Satan vient et enlève la parole semée en eux.
fr.B: Certains sont comme les graines tombées au bord du chemin : la parole est semée en eux, mais dès qu’ils l’ont entendue, Satan vient et emporte la parole qui a été semée en eux.
fr.R: Certaines personnes sont comme le chemin où les graines sont tombées. Elles entendent le message de Dieu, mais tout de suite Satan arrive. Il enlève le message qui a été planté en elles.

sw.L: Na hawa ndio wale walio kando ya njia, mahali neno linapopandwa; na wanaposikia, mara Shetani anakuja na kuliondoa neno lililopandwa ndani yao.
sw.B: Watu wengine ni kama mbegu iliyopandwa kando ya njia. Neno linapandwa ndani yao, nao wanalisikia, lakini mara moja Shetani anakuja na kulinyakua neno lililopandwa ndani yao.
sw.R: Watu wengine ni kama njia ambapo mbegu zilianguka. Wanasikia ujumbe wa Mungu, lakini mara moja Shetani anakuja. Anauondoa ujumbe uliopandwa ndani yao.

decisions.choice: these are the ones along the path: people are pictured as the places where seed falls
decisions.reason: The picture moves between seed and soil. The point is what happens to the word in each kind of hearer.

decisions.choice: Satan: the adversary, the devil
decisions.reason: The birds of 4:4 stand for Satan, who opposes God's work (1:13; 3:23).

decisions.choice: Some people are like
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the comparison plain.

decisions.choice: "곧" (L); "곧바로" (B); "바로" (R) for euthys, through chapter 4
decisions.reason: Mark's frequent "immediately" keeps one Korean word per level so the pace of his telling stays visible; "즉시" sounds administrative in narrative.

decisions.choice: Algunos son como (B); Algunas personas son como (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable say that the people are pictured as the places where the seed falls (meaning decision m1).

source.text: καὶ οὗτοί εἰσιν ὁμοίως οἱ ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη σπειρόμενοι, οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς μετὰ χαρᾶς λαμβάνουσιν αὐτόν, καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν ῥίζαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιροί εἰσιν, εἶτα γενομένης θλίψεως ἢ διωγμοῦ διὰ τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς σκανδαλίζονται.

records.literal_gloss: And these are likewise the [ones] upon the rocky [places] being sown, who when they hear the word immediately with joy receive it, \v 17 and not they have root in themselves but temporary are; then having come trouble or persecution because of the word immediately they fall away.

en.L: And these likewise are the ones sown on the rocky ground: when they hear the word, they immediately receive it with joy, \v 17 and they have no root in themselves, but they are temporary; then when trouble or persecution comes because of the word, immediately they fall away.
en.B: In the same way, others are like seed sown on rocky ground. When they hear the word, they welcome it at once with joy, \v 17 but it takes no root in them, and they last only a short while. Then, when hardship or persecution arises on account of the word, they soon fall away.
en.R: Other people are like the rocky ground. They hear God's message and right away they accept it with joy. \v 17 But they do not let it go deep into them, so they last only a short time. Then trouble comes, or people treat them badly because of the message. Right away they turn away from it.

vi.L: Và những người này cũng vậy, là những người được gieo trên nơi đất đá: khi họ nghe lời, lập tức vui mừng tiếp nhận lời ấy, \v 17 nhưng họ không có rễ trong mình, mà chỉ tạm thời; rồi khi gặp hoạn nạn hay bắt bớ vì lời ấy, lập tức họ vấp ngã.
vi.B: Cũng vậy, có những người giống như hạt gieo trên nơi đất đá. Khi nghe lời, họ liền vui mừng đón nhận, \v 17 nhưng lời không đâm rễ trong họ, nên họ chỉ bền được ít lâu. Rồi khi gặp hoạn nạn hay bị bắt bớ vì lời ấy, họ liền vấp ngã.
vi.R: Có những người khác giống như chỗ đất có đá. Họ nghe sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời và vui mừng nhận ngay. \v 17 Nhưng họ không để sứ điệp ăn sâu vào lòng, nên họ chỉ theo được một thời gian ngắn. Rồi khi gặp khó khăn, hoặc khi bị người ta ngược đãi vì sứ điệp ấy, họ liền từ bỏ niềm tin.

ko.L: 그리고 이와 같이 돌밭에 뿌려지는 사람들은 이런 사람들이다. 그들은 말씀을 들을 때에 곧 기쁨으로 그것을 받는다. \v 17 그러나 그들 속에 뿌리가 없어서 잠시뿐인 사람들이다. 그래서 말씀 때문에 환난이나 박해가 일어나면 곧 걸려 넘어진다.
ko.B: 마찬가지로, 어떤 사람들은 돌밭에 뿌려진 것과 같다. 그들은 말씀을 들으면 곧 기쁨으로 받아들인다. \v 17 그러나 말씀이 그들 속에 뿌리를 내리지 못해서 잠깐 동안만 견딘다. 그래서 말씀 때문에 어려움이나 박해가 닥치면 곧 넘어지고 만다.
ko.R: 또 어떤 사람들은 돌이 많은 땅과 같다. 그들은 하나님의 말씀을 들으면 바로 기쁨으로 받아들인다. \v 17 그러나 말씀이 마음속 깊이 들어가지 못하게 해서 오래가지 못한다. 그러다가 말씀 때문에 어려운 일이 생기거나 사람들이 괴롭히면, 곧바로 말씀에서 떠나 버린다.

es.L: Y estos son, de igual manera, los sembrados en terreno pedregoso: los que, cuando oyen la palabra, enseguida la reciben con gozo, \v 17 y no tienen raíz en sí mismos, sino que son temporales; luego, cuando viene la aflicción o la persecución por causa de la palabra, enseguida tropiezan.
es.B: Del mismo modo, otros son como la semilla sembrada en terreno pedregoso. Cuando oyen la palabra, la reciben enseguida con gozo, \v 17 pero no echa raíz en ellos y duran poco tiempo. Luego, cuando llegan las dificultades o la persecución por causa de la palabra, pronto se apartan.
es.R: Otras personas son como el terreno lleno de piedras. Oyen el mensaje de Dios y enseguida lo aceptan con alegría. \v 17 Pero no dejan que les llegue hasta lo profundo, así que solo duran poco tiempo. Luego llegan los problemas, o la gente los maltrata por causa del mensaje. Enseguida se apartan de él.

fr.L: Et ceux-ci sont de même ceux qui sont semés sur les sols pierreux : quand ils entendent la parole, aussitôt ils la reçoivent avec joie, \v 17 et ils n’ont pas de racine en eux-mêmes, mais ils ne durent qu’un temps ; puis, quand survient la détresse ou la persécution à cause de la parole, aussitôt ils trébuchent.
fr.B: De même, d’autres sont comme les graines semées sur le sol pierreux. Quand ils entendent la parole, ils l’accueillent tout de suite avec joie, \v 17 mais elle ne prend pas racine en eux, et ils ne tiennent qu’un temps. Puis, quand arrivent les difficultés ou la persécution à cause de la parole, ils abandonnent aussitôt.
fr.R: D’autres personnes sont comme le sol plein de pierres. Elles entendent le message de Dieu et tout de suite elles l’accueillent avec joie. \v 17 Mais elles ne le laissent pas s’enfoncer profondément en elles, alors elles ne tiennent pas longtemps. Puis des difficultés arrivent, ou bien des gens les maltraitent à cause du message. Tout de suite, elles s’en détournent.

sw.L: Na hawa vivyo hivyo ndio wanaopandwa penye mawe: wanaposikia neno, mara hulipokea kwa furaha, \v 17 nao hawana mizizi ndani yao wenyewe, bali ni wa kitambo tu; kisha dhiki au mateso yanapotokea kwa sababu ya neno, mara wanakwazwa.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, wengine ni kama mbegu iliyopandwa penye mawe. Wanaposikia neno, mara moja hulipokea kwa furaha. \v 17 Lakini neno haliingii ndani yao likapata mizizi, nao hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha dhiki au mateso yanapokuja kwa sababu ya neno, mara wanarudi nyuma.
sw.R: Watu wengine ni kama ardhi yenye mawe. Wanasikia ujumbe wa Mungu, na mara moja wanaupokea kwa furaha. \v 17 Lakini hawauruhusu uingie ndani yao kwa kina, kwa hiyo wanadumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha shida zinakuja, au watu wanawatesa kwa sababu ya ujumbe huo. Mara moja wanauacha.

decisions.choice: no root in themselves: the word does not go deep into them
decisions.reason: As with the plant in 4:6, there is a quick start but nothing below the surface.

decisions.choice: trouble: pressure, hardship
decisions.reason: The word means pressure from outside, such as suffering for the faith.

decisions.choice: fall away: stumble, give up their trust
decisions.reason: The verb means to be tripped up so as to fall. Jesus uses it of the disciples deserting him (14:27).

decisions.choice: they do not let it go deep into them; they turn away from it
alternatives: they have no root in themselves; they fall away
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture in plain words.

decisions.choice: "vấp ngã" (L, B); "từ bỏ niềm tin" (R)
decisions.reason: "Vấp ngã" keeps the picture of stumbling in the Greek verb; "sa ngã" would suggest moral sin. Readable says plainly what the stumbling is, as the meaning decision explains it.

decisions.choice: "걸려 넘어지다" (L); "넘어지다" (B); "말씀에서 떠나 버리다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek pictures stumbling over a trap; Literal keeps the picture, Balanced the plain verb, and Readable says what it means. "실족하다" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: "기쁨" at every level
decisions.reason: Joy is a key term; Korean keeps the noun at every level ("기쁨으로").

decisions.choice: gozo (L, B); alegría (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Peter 1:6: "gozo" for the key term joy at Literal and Balanced, the everyday "alegría" at Readable.

decisions.choice: tropiezan (L); se apartan (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to stumble and give up their trust (meaning decision m3). "Escandalizarse" now means being shocked; Literal keeps the picture of stumbling.

decisions.choice: ils trébuchent (L); ils abandonnent (B); elles s’en détournent (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to stumble and give up their trust (meaning decision m3). "Être scandalisé" today means to be outraged, which is not the sense; Literal keeps the picture of stumbling, Balanced and Readable say what happens.

decisions.choice: Elles ... elles (R), agreeing with "personnes"
decisions.reason: Readable speaks of "personnes", an inclusive noun, so its pronouns are feminine by grammar; no gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: wanakwazwa (L); wanarudi nyuma (B); wanauacha (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is to stumble, to give up their trust (m3). Literal uses "kukwazwa" (to be made to stumble), the usual Swahili for this verb; Balanced says "kurudi nyuma" (to turn back), and Readable "they leave it", as the English Readable says "they turn away from it".

source.text: καὶ ἄλλοι εἰσὶν οἱ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας σπειρόμενοι· οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ τὸν λόγον ἀκούσαντες, καὶ αἱ μέριμναι τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ἀπάτη τοῦ πλούτου καὶ αἱ περὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι εἰσπορευόμεναι συμπνίγουσιν τὸν λόγον, καὶ ἄκαρπος γίνεται.

records.literal_gloss: And others are the [ones] among the thorns being sown; these are the [ones] the word having heard, \v 19 and the cares of the age and the deceit of the riches and the about the other things desires entering in choke the word, and unfruitful it becomes.

en.L: And others are the ones sown among the thorns; these are the ones who heard the word, \v 19 and the cares of the age and the deceitfulness of riches and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
en.B: Still others are like seed sown among thorns. They hear the word, \v 19 but worries about this present age, the false promise of wealth, and longing for other things crowd in and smother the word, so that it bears no fruit.
en.R: Other people are like the ground with thorny weeds. They hear God's message. \v 19 But then they worry about the things of this life. They are fooled by the promise of riches. They want many other things. All these things crowd out the message, so it does not produce anything in their lives.

vi.L: Và những người khác là những người được gieo vào giữa bụi gai; đó là những người đã nghe lời, \v 19 nhưng những lo toan của đời này, sự lừa dối của giàu sang, và những ham muốn về các thứ khác len vào làm nghẹt lời, và lời trở nên không kết quả.
vi.B: Lại có những người giống như hạt gieo vào giữa bụi gai. Họ nghe lời, \v 19 nhưng những lo toan của đời này, sự quyến rũ giả dối của giàu sang, và lòng ham muốn những thứ khác len vào, làm nghẹt lời, nên lời không sinh hoa kết quả.
vi.R: Những người khác giống như chỗ đất có cỏ gai. Họ nghe sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. \v 19 Nhưng rồi họ lo lắng về những việc của đời này. Họ bị tiền của lừa gạt. Họ ham muốn nhiều thứ khác. Tất cả những điều ấy chèn ép sứ điệp, nên sứ điệp không sinh ra điều gì tốt trong đời sống họ.

ko.L: 또 다른 사람들은 가시덤불 속에 뿌려지는 사람들이다. 이들은 말씀을 들었으나, \v 19 이 시대의 염려와 재물의 속임수와 그 밖의 것들에 대한 욕심이 들어와서 말씀을 숨 막히게 하니, 그것이 열매를 맺지 못하게 된다.
ko.B: 또 어떤 사람들은 가시덤불 속에 뿌려진 것과 같다. 그들은 말씀을 듣지만, \v 19 이 세상살이의 걱정과 재물의 헛된 약속과 그 밖의 여러 가지 욕심이 들어와 말씀을 막아 버려서, 말씀이 열매를 맺지 못한다.
ko.R: 또 어떤 사람들은 가시덤불이 있는 땅과 같다. 그들은 하나님의 말씀을 듣는다. \v 19 그러나 이 세상 일들을 걱정한다. 부자가 되면 행복할 것이라는 생각에 속는다. 그리고 다른 많은 것을 갖고 싶어 한다. 이런 것들이 말씀을 덮어 버려서, 말씀이 그들의 삶에서 아무 열매도 맺지 못한다.

es.L: Y otros son los sembrados entre los espinos; estos son los que oyeron la palabra, \v 19 y las preocupaciones de esta era, y el engaño de las riquezas, y los deseos de las demás cosas entran y ahogan la palabra, y se vuelve infructuosa.
es.B: Otros son como la semilla sembrada entre espinos. Oyen la palabra, \v 19 pero las preocupaciones de este tiempo presente, las falsas promesas de la riqueza y el deseo de otras cosas los invaden y ahogan la palabra, de modo que no da fruto.
es.R: Otras personas son como el terreno con hierbas espinosas. Oyen el mensaje de Dios. \v 19 Pero luego se preocupan por las cosas de esta vida. Se dejan engañar por lo que promete el dinero. Quieren muchas otras cosas. Todo eso ahoga el mensaje, así que no produce nada en su vida.

fr.L: Et d’autres sont ceux qui sont semés parmi les épines ; ce sont ceux qui ont entendu la parole, \v 19 et les soucis de l’âge [présent], et la séduction de la richesse, et les désirs pour les autres choses, entrant, étouffent la parole, et elle devient sans fruit.
fr.B: D’autres encore sont comme les graines semées parmi les ronces. Ils entendent la parole, \v 19 mais les soucis de ce monde, l’attrait trompeur de la richesse et l’envie de bien d’autres choses s’introduisent en eux et étouffent la parole, si bien qu’elle ne porte pas de fruit.
fr.R: D’autres personnes sont comme la terre où il y a des mauvaises herbes pleines d’épines. Elles entendent le message de Dieu. \v 19 Mais ensuite, elles se font du souci pour les choses de cette vie. Elles se laissent tromper par ce que la richesse promet. Elles veulent beaucoup d’autres choses. Tout cela étouffe le message, et il ne produit rien dans leur vie.

sw.L: Na wengine ndio wanaopandwa kati ya miiba; hawa ndio waliolisikia neno, \v 19 na masumbufu ya zama, na udanganyifu wa mali, na tamaa za mambo mengine, vinaingia na kulisonga neno, nalo linakuwa halizai.
sw.B: Wengine ni kama mbegu iliyopandwa kati ya miiba. Hao hulisikia neno, \v 19 lakini wasiwasi wa zama hizi, ahadi za uongo za mali, na tamaa ya mambo mengine huingia na kulisonga neno, hata lisizae matunda.
sw.R: Watu wengine ni kama ardhi yenye magugu ya miiba. Wanasikia ujumbe wa Mungu. \v 19 Lakini kisha wanahangaikia mambo ya maisha haya. Wanadanganywa na ahadi za utajiri. Wanatamani mambo mengine mengi. Mambo hayo yote yanausonga ujumbe ule, hata hauzai chochote maishani mwao.

decisions.choice: cares of the age: worries that belong to life in this present world
decisions.reason: "The age" is the present time, set against the age to come (10:30).

decisions.choice: deceit of riches: wealth promises what it cannot give
decisions.reason: The word means deceit. In some later Greek it means pleasure, and a few read it so here.

decisions.choice: it becomes unfruitful: the word bears no crop in them
decisions.reason: The subject is most likely the word, though the result is the same for the hearer.

decisions.choice: the false promise of wealth
decisions.reason: Balanced says how riches deceive.

decisions.choice: in their lives
decisions.reason: Readable says where the crop should have grown.

decisions.choice: "những lo toan của đời này" for the cares of the age
decisions.reason: "Đời này" is life in the present world, the sense of the meaning decision; "thời đại" would mean a historical period.

decisions.choice: "이 시대" (L); "이 세상살이" (B); "이 세상 일들" (R) for aion
decisions.reason: "세상" is the Korean John's word for kosmos; Literal keeps aion apart as "시대" (age), while Balanced and Readable say what these worries belong to, life in this present world.

decisions.choice: de esta era (L); de este tiempo presente (B); de esta vida (R)
decisions.reason: The cares that belong to life in the present age (meaning decision m1). "Del siglo" is the older literal wording but is now heard as "of the century".

decisions.choice: las falsas promesas de la riqueza
decisions.reason: As in English: wealth promises what it cannot give (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps "el engaño de las riquezas".

decisions.choice: les soucis de l’âge [présent], la séduction de la richesse (L); les soucis de ce monde, l’attrait trompeur de la richesse (B)
decisions.reason: The worries belong to life in this present age (meaning decision m1), and wealth deceives by promising what it cannot give (m2). "Siècle" in this sense is old-fashioned; Literal says "l’âge" and brackets "présent"; Balanced says "ce monde" and "attrait trompeur".

decisions.choice: zama (the age)
decisions.reason: As in Galatians 1:4, "zama" is an age or era, the present world-age (m1); "ulimwengu" would be the world itself. Readable says "maisha haya" (this life), as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἐκεῖνοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν καλὴν σπαρέντες, οἵτινες ἀκούουσιν τὸν λόγον καὶ παραδέχονται καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἓν τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑκατόν.

records.literal_gloss: And those are the [ones] upon the soil the good having been sown, who hear the word and receive and bear fruit one thirty and one sixty and one a hundred.

en.L: And those are the ones sown on the good soil: such as hear the word and accept [it] and bear fruit, thirtyfold and sixtyfold and a hundredfold."
en.B: But others are like seed sown in good soil. These hear the word, welcome it, and bear a crop, thirty, sixty, or a hundred times what was sown."
en.R: But some people are like the good soil. They hear God's message and accept it. Then they produce a good crop, thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times as much as was planted."

vi.L: Và những người kia là những người được gieo trên đất tốt: họ nghe lời và tiếp nhận, và kết quả, người thì ba mươi, người thì sáu mươi, người thì một trăm."
vi.B: Còn có những người giống như hạt gieo trên đất tốt. Họ nghe lời, đón nhận lời, và sinh hoa kết quả, gấp ba mươi, gấp sáu mươi, hoặc gấp một trăm lần số hạt đã gieo."
vi.R: Nhưng có những người giống như đất tốt. Họ nghe sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời và tiếp nhận sứ điệp ấy. Rồi họ sinh ra một vụ mùa tốt, gấp ba mươi, gấp sáu mươi, hoặc thậm chí gấp một trăm lần số hạt đã gieo."

ko.L: 그리고 좋은 땅에 뿌려진 사람들은 저 사람들이다. 그들은 말씀을 듣고 받아들여서, 어떤 이는 서른 배, 어떤 이는 예순 배, 어떤 이는 백 배의 열매를 맺는다."
ko.B: 그러나 어떤 사람들은 좋은 땅에 뿌려진 것과 같다. 그들은 말씀을 듣고 받아들여서, 뿌린 것의 서른 배나 예순 배나 백 배의 열매를 맺는다."
ko.R: 그러나 어떤 사람들은 좋은 땅과 같다. 그들은 하나님의 말씀을 듣고 받아들인다. 그래서 뿌린 것보다 서른 배, 예순 배, 많게는 백 배나 되는 열매를 맺는다."

es.L: Y aquellos son los sembrados en la tierra buena: los que oyen la palabra y [la] aceptan, y dan fruto a treinta, y a sesenta, y a ciento por uno».
es.B: Pero otros son como la semilla sembrada en tierra buena. Oyen la palabra, la aceptan y dan una cosecha de treinta, sesenta y hasta cien veces lo sembrado».
es.R: Pero algunas personas son como la tierra buena. Oyen el mensaje de Dios y lo aceptan. Luego producen una buena cosecha: treinta, sesenta y hasta cien veces más de lo que se sembró».

fr.L: Et ceux-là sont ceux qui ont été semés sur la bonne terre : ceux qui entendent la parole, et [l’]accueillent, et portent du fruit, l’un trente, l’un soixante, l’un cent. »
fr.B: D’autres enfin sont comme les graines semées dans la bonne terre. Ils entendent la parole, l’accueillent et portent du fruit : trente, soixante ou cent fois ce qui a été semé. »
fr.R: Mais certaines personnes sont comme la bonne terre. Elles entendent le message de Dieu et elles l’acceptent. Alors elles produisent une belle récolte : trente fois, soixante fois ou même cent fois plus que ce qui a été semé. »

sw.L: Na wale ndio waliopandwa katika udongo mzuri, ambao hulisikia neno na kulipokea na kuzaa matunda, moja thelathini, na moja sitini, na moja mia."
sw.B: Lakini wengine ni kama mbegu iliyopandwa katika udongo mzuri. Hao hulisikia neno, hulikubali, na kuzaa mazao, mara thelathini, mara sitini, au mara mia ya kile kilichopandwa."
sw.R: Lakini watu wengine ni kama udongo mzuri. Wanasikia ujumbe wa Mungu na kuukubali. Kisha wanatoa mavuno mazuri, mara thelathini, mara sitini, au hata mara mia ya kile kilichopandwa."

decisions.choice: receive: accept and hold on to
decisions.reason: The verb is stronger than hearing. It means taking the word in as one's own.

decisions.choice: bear fruit: a life that shows the word at work
decisions.reason: The fruit is what the word produces in the hearer. Mark does not say more.

decisions.choice: one thirty, one sixty, one a hundred: as in 4:8
alternatives: in thirty, in sixty, in a hundred
decisions.reason: The same unaccented letters can be read as "one" or "in". The SBLGNT reads "one". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: times what was sown (B); times as much as was planted (R)
decisions.reason: As in 4:8.

decisions.choice: the wording of 4:8 at each level
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats the yields of the parable, so each level repeats its own wording of 4:8.

source.text: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Μήτι ἔρχεται ὁ λύχνος ἵνα ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον τεθῇ ἢ ὑπὸ τὴν κλίνην, οὐχ ἵνα ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τεθῇ;

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying to them, Not comes the lamp so that under the basket it may be put or under the bed? Not that upon the lampstand it may be put?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying to them, "Does the lamp come in to be put under the basket or under the bed? Is it not to be put on the lampstand?
en.B: He also said to them, "Is a lamp brought in to be set under a bowl or under a bed? Is it not meant to go on a lampstand?
en.R: Jesus also said to them, "No one brings a lamp into the house and then hides it under a bowl or under a bed. You put it on a stand, where it can give light.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Đèn đến để bị đặt dưới cái đấu hay dưới gầm giường sao? Chẳng phải để được đặt trên chân đèn sao?
vi.B: Ngài cũng nói với họ: "Đèn được đem vào để úp dưới cái thúng hay để dưới gầm giường sao? Chẳng phải là để đặt trên chân đèn sao?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cũng nói với họ: "Không ai đem đèn vào nhà rồi lại giấu nó dưới cái thúng hay dưới gầm giường. Người ta đặt đèn trên chân đèn để nó soi sáng.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "등불이 오는 것이 말 아래나 침상 아래 두려는 것이냐? 등잔대 위에 두려는 것이 아니냐?
ko.B: 또 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "등불을 가져와서 그릇 아래나 침상 아래에 두느냐? 등잔대 위에 두지 않느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 또 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "등불을 켜서 집 안에 가지고 와서 그릇으로 덮어 두거나 침대 밑에 두는 사람은 없다. 등불은 받침대 위에 놓아서 빛을 비추게 한다.

es.L: Y les decía: «¿Acaso viene la lámpara para ser puesta debajo del cesto o debajo de la cama? ¿No [viene] para ser puesta sobre el candelero?
es.B: También les dijo: «¿Acaso se trae una lámpara para ponerla debajo de una vasija o debajo de la cama? ¿No es para ponerla en el candelero?
es.R: Jesús también les dijo: «Nadie trae una lámpara a la casa para esconderla debajo de una vasija o debajo de la cama. Se pone en un candelero, donde pueda dar luz.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « La lampe vient-elle pour être mise sous le boisseau ou sous le lit ? N’[est-ce] pas pour être mise sur le porte-lampe ?
fr.B: Il leur dit aussi : « Fait-on entrer une lampe pour la mettre sous le boisseau ou sous le lit ? N’est-ce pas pour la placer sur son support ?
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit aussi : « Personne n’apporte une lampe dans la maison pour la cacher sous un seau ou sous un lit. On la pose sur un support, pour qu’elle éclaire.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akiwaambia, "Je, taa inakuja ili iwekwe chini ya pishi au chini ya kitanda? Si ili iwekwe juu ya kinara?
sw.B: Akawaambia pia, "Je, taa huletwa ndani ili ifunikwe kwa bakuli au iwekwe chini ya kitanda? Si huletwa ili iwekwe juu ya kinara?
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia pia, "Hakuna mtu anayeleta taa ndani ya nyumba kisha akaificha chini ya bakuli au chini ya kitanda. Taa huwekwa juu ya kinara, mahali inapoweza kutoa mwanga.

decisions.choice: lamp, basket, bed: a small clay oil lamp, a grain measure, a raised couch
alternatives: a modern lamp, a basket, a bed on the floor
decisions.reason: The basket was a measure for grain, a bowl that could cover a lamp. The bed was a couch raised on legs, used for sleeping or reclining at meals.

decisions.choice: the questions: the first expects "no", the second "yes"
decisions.reason: Nobody hides a lamp; it is brought in to give light.

decisions.choice: comes: the lamp is said to come, not to be brought
alternatives: only a way of saying a lamp is brought in
decisions.reason: The verb is unusual for a lamp. It may hint at Jesus, who came to make things known (1:38).

decisions.choice: two statements in place of questions; where it can give light
decisions.reason: Readable gives the answer the questions expect and says why a lamp goes on a stand.

decisions.choice: "cái đấu" (L); "cái thúng" (B, R) for the grain measure
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a vessel for measuring grain. "Đấu" is the Vietnamese grain measure; "thúng" is the everyday basket a reader can picture covering a lamp.

decisions.choice: "말" (L), "그릇" (B, R) for the grain measure; "침상" (L, B), "침대" (R); "등잔대" (L, B), "받침대" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the measure as the Korean measure "말"; Balanced and Readable say what it was used as, a container that would cover the lamp. "등경" is the older church word for lampstand.

decisions.choice: cesto (L); vasija (B, R); candelero
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a grain measure (meaning decision m1); "almud" is no longer understood, so Literal says "cesto" and Balanced and Readable a household bowl.

decisions.choice: ¿Acaso viene ...?
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of the lamp "coming" (meaning decision m3); "acaso" marks a question that expects the answer no, as in 2:19.

decisions.choice: le boisseau (L, B), un seau (R); le porte-lampe (L), son support (B), un support (R)
decisions.reason: The basket is a grain measure (meaning decision m1). French has the exact word, "boisseau", and it is still known from the saying "mettre la lumière sous le boisseau", so Literal and Balanced keep it; Readable says "seau". "Chandelier" would suggest candles; the lamp is a small clay oil lamp set on a stand.

decisions.choice: La lampe vient-elle (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of the lamp that "comes" (meaning decision m3); Balanced says how a lamp is brought in.

decisions.choice: pishi (L); bakuli (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a grain measure (m1). "Pishi" is a traditional Swahili measure for grain, so Literal can keep the object; Balanced and Readable say "bakuli" (bowl), as the English says "bowl". For review by a native speaker: "pishi" may be unfamiliar to younger readers.

source.text: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κρυπτὸν ἐὰν μὴ ἵνα φανερωθῇ, οὐδὲ ἐγένετο ἀπόκρυφον ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἔλθῃ εἰς φανερόν.

records.literal_gloss: Not for is [anything] hidden except that it be made known, nor has become secret but that it come into the open.

en.L: For there is nothing hidden except to be made known, nor has anything become secret except that it should come into the open.
en.B: For nothing is hidden except to be brought out in the open, and nothing has been kept secret except so that it might come to light.
en.R: Things are hidden only so that later they can be shown. Secrets are kept only so that later they can come out into the open.

vi.L: Vì không có gì bị che giấu mà không phải để được tỏ ra, cũng chẳng có gì trở thành bí mật mà không phải để được đưa ra công khai.
vi.B: Vì không có điều gì bị giấu kín mà không phải để được bày tỏ ra, và chẳng có điều gì được giữ bí mật mà không phải để được đưa ra ánh sáng.
vi.R: Những điều bị giấu kín là để sau này được bày tỏ ra. Những điều bí mật được giữ kín là để sau này được đưa ra cho mọi người biết.

ko.L: 드러나게 하려는 것 말고는 숨겨진 것이 없고, 밝히 나타나게 하려는 것 말고는 감추어진 것이 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 숨겨 둔 것은 드러내려는 것이고, 감추어 둔 것은 밝히 나타내려는 것이다.
ko.R: 무엇을 숨겨 두는 것은 나중에 보여 주려는 것이다. 무엇을 비밀로 하는 것도 나중에 모든 사람이 알게 하려는 것이다.

es.L: Porque no hay nada oculto si no es para que se manifieste, ni nada ha quedado en secreto sino para que salga a la luz.
es.B: Porque no hay nada escondido que no sea para sacarlo a la luz, ni nada guardado en secreto que no sea para darlo a conocer.
es.R: Las cosas se esconden solo para mostrarlas más tarde. Los secretos se guardan solo para que más tarde salgan a la luz.

fr.L: Car il n’y a [rien] de caché, sinon pour être rendu manifeste, et rien n’est devenu secret, sinon pour venir au grand jour.
fr.B: Car rien n’est caché sinon pour être mis au grand jour, et rien n’a été tenu secret sinon pour venir à la lumière.
fr.R: Les choses sont cachées seulement pour être montrées plus tard. Les secrets sont gardés seulement pour être révélés plus tard.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakuna kilichofichwa isipokuwa ili kidhihirishwe, wala hakuna kilichofanywa siri isipokuwa ili kije wazi.
sw.B: Kwa maana hakuna kilichofichwa ila ili kifichuliwe, na hakuna kilichowekwa siri ila ili kije kujulikana wazi.
sw.R: Mambo hufichwa ili baadaye yaonyeshwe. Siri hutunzwa ili baadaye zije kujulikana wazi.

decisions.choice: except that it be made known: hiding is for the sake of later showing
alternatives: everything hidden will be found out
decisions.reason: The clauses state purpose. What is now hidden in parables, the mystery of 4:11, is meant to be made plain.

decisions.choice: hidden: God's kingdom is now veiled, but it will be seen
decisions.reason: In this setting the hidden thing is the kingdom, not people's secrets.

decisions.choice: later
decisions.reason: Readable says that the showing comes after the hiding.

source.text: εἴ τις ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω.

records.literal_gloss: If anyone has ears to hear let him hear.

en.L: If anyone has ears to hear, let {{gender:them|him}} hear."
en.B: If anyone has ears to hear, let that person listen."
en.R: If you have ears, then listen!"

vi.L: Nếu ai có tai để nghe, hãy nghe."
vi.B: Nếu ai có tai để nghe, người ấy hãy lắng nghe."
vi.R: Ai có tai thì hãy nghe cho kỹ!"

ko.L: 누구든지 들을 귀가 있거든 들어라."
ko.B: 들을 귀가 있는 사람은 잘 들어라."
ko.R: 귀가 있으면 잘 들어라!"

es.L: Si alguno tiene oídos para oír, que oiga».
es.B: Si alguien tiene oídos para oír, que escuche».
es.R: Si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} oídos, ¡{{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}!».

fr.L: Si quelqu’un a des oreilles pour entendre, qu’il entende. »
fr.B: Si quelqu’un a des oreilles pour entendre, qu’il écoute ! »
fr.R: Si vous avez des oreilles, alors écoutez ! »

sw.L: Mtu yeyote akiwa na masikio ya kusikia, na asikie."
sw.B: Mtu yeyote akiwa na masikio ya kusikia, na asikilize."
sw.R: Kama una masikio, basi sikiliza!"

decisions.choice: has ears to hear: is able and willing to take this in
decisions.reason: The same call as in 4:9.

decisions.choice: them (default), him (alternative)
decisions.reason: As in 4:9.

decisions.choice: que oiga, no gender span
