source.text: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Βλέπετε τί ἀκούετε.

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying to them, Watch what you hear.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying to them, "Take care what you hear.
en.B: He also said to them, "Pay attention to what you hear.
en.R: He also said, "Think carefully about what you hear.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Hãy coi chừng điều các con nghe.
vi.B: Ngài cũng nói với họ: "Hãy chú ý đến những gì các con nghe.
vi.R: Ngài cũng nói: "Hãy suy nghĩ kỹ về những gì các con nghe.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희가 무엇을 듣는지 잘 살펴라.
ko.B: 또 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희가 듣는 것에 주의하여라.
ko.R: 예수께서 또 말씀하셨다. "너희가 듣는 말을 잘 생각해 보아라.

es.L: Y les decía: «{{plural_you:Tengan cuidado con lo que oyen|Tened cuidado con lo que oís}}.
es.B: También les dijo: «{{plural_you:Presten atención a lo que oyen|Prestad atención a lo que oís}}.
es.R: También les dijo: «{{plural_you:Piensen bien en lo que oyen|Pensad bien en lo que oís}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur disait : « Prenez garde à ce que vous entendez.
fr.B: Il leur dit encore : « Faites attention à ce que vous entendez.
fr.R: Il a dit aussi : « Réfléchissez bien à ce que vous entendez.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akiwaambia, "Angalieni mnachosikia.
sw.B: Akawaambia pia, "Zingatieni kile mnachosikia.
sw.R: Akawaambia pia, "Fikirini kwa makini kuhusu kile mnachosikia.

decisions.choice: watch: take care, pay attention
decisions.reason: The verb means "see", but as a command it means "be careful" (8:15).

decisions.choice: what you hear: the word Jesus speaks
decisions.reason: The command is about attending to the message, which the next saying explains.

source.text: ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν καὶ προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: With what measure you measure it will be measured to you, and will be added to you.

en.L: With the measure you measure [with], it will be measured to you, and more will be added to you.
en.B: Whatever measure you use, God will use the same for you, and will give you more besides.
en.R: As you listen, so God will give to you. In fact, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give you even more.

vi.L: Các con đong bằng đấu nào, thì sẽ được đong lại cho các con bằng đấu ấy, và còn được thêm cho các con nữa.
vi.B: Các con dùng đấu nào để đong, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ dùng chính đấu ấy mà đong cho các con, và còn cho thêm nữa.
vi.R: Các con lắng nghe thế nào thì Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban cho các con thể ấy. Thật ra, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ còn ban cho các con nhiều hơn nữa.

ko.L: 너희가 헤아리는 그 헤아림으로 너희에게 헤아려질 것이고, 너희에게 더해질 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 되어 주는 그 되로 하나님께서도 너희에게 되어 주실 것이고, 거기에 더 얹어 주실 것이다.
ko.R: 너희가 듣는 만큼 하나님께서도 너희에게 주실 것이다. 아니, 그보다 더 많이 주실 것이다.

es.L: Con la medida con que {{plural_you:miden|medís}} se {{plural_you:les|os}} medirá, y se {{plural_you:les|os}} añadirá [más].
es.B: Con la medida que {{plural_you:usen|uséis}}, Dios {{plural_you:los medirá a ustedes|os medirá a vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:les|os}} dará aún más.
es.R: Según como {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}}, así Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dará. De hecho, {{plural_you:les|os}} dará todavía más.

fr.L: Avec la mesure dont vous mesurez, il vous sera mesuré, et il vous sera ajouté.
fr.B: La mesure dont vous vous servez, Dieu s’en servira pour vous, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous donnera encore davantage.
fr.R: Dieu vous donnera dans la mesure où vous écoutez. Et même, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous donnera encore plus.

sw.L: Kwa kipimo mnachopimia, mtapimiwa, na mtaongezewa.
sw.B: Kipimo mnachotumia ndicho Mungu atakachotumia kwenu, naye atawaongezea zaidi.
sw.R: Jinsi mnavyosikiliza, ndivyo Mungu atakavyowapa. Tena atawapa hata zaidi.

decisions.choice: the measure you measure with: you will receive in the way you give
alternatives: a rule about weights in trade
decisions.reason: This is a proverb from buying and selling grain. Here it is about the attention one gives to Jesus' word; it is not a unit of measure.

decisions.choice: it will be measured, it will be added: God will do it
decisions.reason: The passive verbs leave the giver unnamed, pointing to God.

decisions.choice: added: given beyond what is deserved
decisions.reason: God gives more than the measure: those who listen will be given more understanding.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who gives.

decisions.choice: As you listen, so God will give to you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the measure stands for here.

decisions.choice: "đong bằng đấu" for measuring with a measure
decisions.reason: "Đong" is the everyday verb for measuring out grain, and "đấu" the measure, so the saying keeps its picture of the market.

decisions.choice: "헤아리다" (L); "되어 주다" with "되" (B)
decisions.reason: The picture is grain measured out (meaning decision). Literal keeps the repeated word with "헤아리다" (measure); Balanced uses the Korean picture of measuring grain with a "되", which says the same thing in everyday speech.

decisions.choice: Dios
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who measures and gives (meaning decision m2). Readable's second sentence needs no pronoun in Spanish, so it has no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: [más]
decisions.reason: Spanish "añadir" needs to say what is added.

decisions.choice: il vous sera ajouté (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the impersonal passive, which in French can stand without a subject; Balanced and Readable name God as the giver, as the English does (meaning decision m2).

source.text: ὃς γὰρ ἔχει, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ· καὶ ὃς οὐκ ἔχει, καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Who for has, it will be given to him; and who not has, even what he has will be taken from him.

en.L: For whoever has, it will be given to {{gender:them|him}}; and whoever does not have, even what {{gender:they have|he has}} will be taken away from {{gender:them|him}}."
en.B: Those who have will be given more, and those who do not have will lose even what they have."
en.R: People who have something will be given more. People who have nothing will lose even the little they have."

vi.L: Vì ai có, sẽ được cho thêm; còn ai không có, thì ngay cả điều người ấy có cũng sẽ bị lấy đi."
vi.B: Ai đã có sẽ được cho thêm, còn ai không có thì ngay cả điều mình có cũng sẽ bị lấy mất."
vi.R: Ai có một chút gì thì sẽ được cho thêm. Ai không có gì thì ngay cả chút ít mình có cũng sẽ bị lấy mất."

ko.L: 가진 사람은 받을 것이고, 가지지 않은 사람은 가진 것마저 빼앗길 것이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 가진 사람은 더 받을 것이고, 가지지 못한 사람은 가진 것마저 빼앗길 것이다."
ko.R: 무엇이든 가진 사람은 더 받게 된다. 그러나 아무것도 갖지 못한 사람은 그나마 가진 조금마저 빼앗기게 된다."

es.L: Porque al que tiene, se le dará; y al que no tiene, aun lo que tiene se le quitará».
es.B: A los que tienen se les dará más, y a los que no tienen se les quitará incluso lo que tienen».
es.R: A las personas que tienen algo se les dará más. A las que no tienen nada se les quitará hasta lo poco que tienen».

fr.L: Car celui qui a, il lui sera donné ; et celui qui n’a pas, même ce qu’il a lui sera enlevé. »
fr.B: Celui qui a recevra davantage, et celui qui n’a pas perdra même ce qu’il a. »
fr.R: Les gens qui ont quelque chose recevront plus. Les gens qui n’ont rien perdront même le peu qu’ils ont. »

sw.L: Kwa maana aliye nacho atapewa; na asiye nacho, hata kile alicho nacho atanyang'anywa."
sw.B: Wale walio nacho wataongezewa, na wasio nacho watanyang'anywa hata kile walicho nacho."
sw.R: Watu walio na kitu watapewa zaidi. Watu wasio na kitu watapoteza hata kile kidogo walicho nacho."

decisions.choice: has: has received the word and holds it
decisions.reason: In this setting what one "has" is the word that was heard (4:24).

decisions.choice: will be given, will be taken away: God gives and takes
decisions.reason: The passive points to God, as in 4:24.

decisions.choice: those who (B); people who (R)
decisions.reason: Plural forms include men and women without a setting.

decisions.choice: the little
decisions.reason: Readable shows that they had only a little.

decisions.choice: al que ... se le, no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "al que" and "le" already include everyone, so the English gender spans have no counterpart.

source.text: Καὶ ἔλεγεν· Οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ὡς ἄνθρωπος βάλῃ τὸν σπόρον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ καθεύδῃ καὶ ἐγείρηται νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν, καὶ ὁ σπόρος βλαστᾷ καὶ μηκύνηται ὡς οὐκ οἶδεν αὐτός.

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying, Thus is the kingdom of the God, as a man should throw the seed upon the earth \v 27 and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should sprout and lengthen, how not knows he.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying, "The kingdom of God is like this: as if a man should throw seed on the ground \v 27 and sleep and rise night and day, and the seed sprouts and grows, he does not know how.
en.B: He also said, "It is like this with the kingdom of God: a man throws seed on the ground. \v 27 He goes to sleep at night and gets up by day, and the seed sprouts and grows tall, though he does not know how.
en.R: Jesus also said, "This is what the kingdom of God is like. Think of a man who plants seed in the ground. \v 27 Each night he goes to sleep, and each day he gets up. All the while, the seed comes up and grows. He does not know how it happens.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời thì như thế này: như một người vãi hạt giống trên đất, \v 27 rồi ngủ và thức dậy, đêm và ngày, và hạt giống nảy mầm và mọc dài ra, mà chính người ấy không biết thế nào.
vi.B: Ngài cũng nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời giống như thế này: một người vãi hạt giống xuống đất. \v 27 Đêm thì người ấy đi ngủ, ngày thì thức dậy, và hạt giống nảy mầm, mọc cao lên, mà người ấy không biết bằng cách nào.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cũng nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời giống như thế này. Hãy nghĩ đến một người gieo hạt xuống đất. \v 27 Mỗi đêm người ấy đi ngủ, mỗi sáng người ấy thức dậy. Trong lúc đó, hạt giống nảy mầm và lớn lên. Người ấy không biết nó lớn lên thế nào.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라는 이와 같다. 어떤 사람이 땅에 씨를 뿌리고, \v 27 밤낮 자고 일어나고 하는 동안, 씨가 싹이 트고 자라나는데, 그는 어떻게 그렇게 되는지 알지 못한다.
ko.B: 또 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라는 이와 같다. 어떤 사람이 땅에 씨를 뿌려 놓았다. \v 27 그가 밤에는 자고 낮에는 일어나는 사이에, 씨는 싹이 나고 자라지만, 그는 어떻게 그렇게 되는지 모른다.
ko.R: 예수께서 또 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라는 이런 것과 같다. 어떤 사람이 땅에 씨를 뿌렸다고 생각해 보아라. \v 27 그는 밤마다 자고, 아침마다 일어난다. 그러는 동안 씨는 싹이 나고 자란다. 그 사람은 그것이 어떻게 자라는지 모른다.

es.L: Y decía: «Así es el reino de Dios: como un hombre que echa la semilla sobre la tierra, \v 27 y duerme y se levanta, de noche y de día, y la semilla brota y crece sin que él sepa cómo.
es.B: También dijo: «Con el reino de Dios sucede lo siguiente: un hombre echa semilla en la tierra. \v 27 Por la noche se duerme y de día se levanta, y la semilla brota y crece, aunque él no sabe cómo.
es.R: Jesús también dijo: «Así es el reino de Dios. {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en un hombre que siembra semilla en la tierra. \v 27 Cada noche se va a dormir, y cada día se levanta. Mientras tanto, la semilla brota y crece. Él no sabe cómo sucede.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait : « Il en est du royaume de Dieu comme d’un homme qui jetterait la semence sur la terre, \v 27 et qui dormirait et se lèverait, nuit et jour, et la semence germe et s’allonge, il ne sait pas comment.
fr.B: Il dit encore : « Voici à quoi ressemble le royaume de Dieu : un homme jette la semence en terre. \v 27 Il dort la nuit, il se lève le jour, et la semence germe et grandit, sans qu’il sache comment.
fr.R: Jésus a dit aussi : « Voici comment est le royaume de Dieu. Pensez à un homme qui sème des graines dans la terre. \v 27 Chaque soir, il va dormir, et chaque matin, il se lève. Pendant ce temps, la graine pousse et grandit. Il ne sait pas comment cela se fait.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akisema, "Ufalme wa Mungu ni hivi: kama mtu atupaye mbegu juu ya ardhi, \v 27 akalala na kuamka usiku na mchana, na mbegu ikachipua na kurefuka, yeye mwenyewe asijue jinsi gani.
sw.B: Akasema pia, "Ufalme wa Mungu uko hivi: mtu hutupa mbegu ardhini. \v 27 Usiku analala, mchana anaamka, na mbegu inachipua na kukua, ingawa yeye hajui jinsi inavyokua.
sw.R: Yesu akasema pia, "Ufalme wa Mungu uko hivi. Fikiria mtu anayepanda mbegu shambani. \v 27 Kila usiku analala, na kila asubuhi anaamka. Wakati huo wote mbegu inaota na kukua. Yeye hajui jinsi inavyotokea.

decisions.choice: the seed grows without the man's help or knowledge
decisions.reason: The point is that God makes the kingdom grow. The man's part is to sow and later to reap.

decisions.choice: night and day: day after day
decisions.reason: Jews counted the day from evening, so night comes first.

decisions.choice: grows: lengthens, grows tall
decisions.reason: The verb means to become long, as a stalk does.

decisions.choice: Each night he goes to sleep, and each day he gets up
alternatives: sleep and rise night and day
decisions.reason: Readable pairs each action with its time.

decisions.choice: el reino de Dios
decisions.reason: As in 1:14: the same words at every level and throughout Mark.

decisions.choice: un homme, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: A figure in a parable, one particular man who sows, as the English says "a man" with no span.

source.text: αὐτομάτη ἡ γῆ καρποφορεῖ, πρῶτον χόρτον, εἶτα στάχυν, εἶτα πλήρης σῖτον ἐν τῷ στάχυϊ.

records.literal_gloss: Of itself the earth bears fruit, first blade, then ear, then full grain in the ear.

en.L: By itself the earth bears fruit, first a blade, then an ear, then full grain in the ear.
en.B: The earth bears its crop on its own: first the green blade, then the ear, then the ear full of grain.
en.R: The ground makes the plants grow all by itself. First a green shoot comes up. Then the head of grain forms. Then the head fills up with grain.

vi.L: Đất tự sinh ra trái: trước hết là ngọn non, rồi đến bông, rồi đến hạt chắc trong bông.
vi.B: Đất tự nó sinh ra hoa lợi: trước hết là cây non, kế đến là bông, rồi đến bông đầy hạt chắc.
vi.R: Đất tự làm cho cây lớn lên. Trước hết, một mầm xanh nhú lên. Sau đó cây trổ bông. Rồi bông đầy những hạt chắc.

ko.L: 땅이 저절로 열매를 맺어, 먼저 싹을, 그다음에 이삭을, 그다음에 이삭에 가득 찬 낟알을 낸다.
ko.B: 땅이 스스로 곡식을 내는데, 처음에는 싹이 나고, 다음에는 이삭이 패고, 그다음에는 이삭에 낟알이 가득 찬다.
ko.R: 땅이 혼자서 곡식을 자라게 한다. 먼저 푸른 싹이 나온다. 그다음에 이삭이 생긴다. 그리고 이삭에 낟알이 가득 찬다.

es.L: Por sí misma la tierra da fruto: primero hierba, luego espiga, luego grano lleno en la espiga.
es.B: La tierra da su cosecha por sí sola: primero el tallo verde, luego la espiga, y después la espiga llena de grano.
es.R: La tierra hace crecer las plantas por sí sola. Primero sale un brote verde. Luego se forma la espiga. Después la espiga se llena de grano.

fr.L: D’elle-même la terre porte du fruit : d’abord l’herbe, puis l’épi, puis le grain plein dans l’épi.
fr.B: La terre produit sa récolte d’elle-même : d’abord la tige verte, puis l’épi, puis le grain qui remplit l’épi.
fr.R: C’est la terre qui fait pousser les plantes, toute seule. D’abord une petite pousse verte sort de terre. Ensuite l’épi se forme. Puis l’épi se remplit de grains.

sw.L: Ardhi yenyewe huzaa matunda: kwanza jani, kisha suke, kisha nafaka kamili katika suke.
sw.B: Ardhi huzaa mazao yenyewe: kwanza chipukizi, kisha suke, kisha suke lililojaa nafaka.
sw.R: Ardhi yenyewe inaifanya mimea ikue. Kwanza chipukizi kibichi kinaota. Kisha suke la nafaka linatokea. Kisha suke linajaa nafaka.

decisions.choice: of itself: without human work
decisions.reason: The word means "automatic". The growth comes from what God has made, not from the farmer.

decisions.choice: blade, ear, full grain: the stages of wheat or barley
decisions.reason: First the green shoot, then the ear or head, then the ripe grain filling the head.

decisions.choice: full grain: the SBLGNT has the form of "full" that does not change its ending
alternatives: a form of "full" that agrees with "grain"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ in the form of the word, not in the sense. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: head of grain
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plainer word for an ear of grain.

decisions.choice: "bông" for the ear of grain, with no word for the crop
decisions.reason: "Lúa" would make a Vietnamese reader picture rice; "lúa mì" names one crop where the meaning decision allows wheat or barley. "Bông" (the ear or head) needs neither.

decisions.choice: l’épi at every level
decisions.reason: French has the plain word "épi" for the head of grain, known to young readers, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable explains.

source.text: ὅταν δὲ παραδοῖ ὁ καρπός, εὐθὺς ἀποστέλλει τὸ δρέπανον, ὅτι παρέστηκεν ὁ θερισμός.

records.literal_gloss: When but permits the fruit, immediately he sends the sickle, because has come the harvest.

en.L: But when the fruit allows, immediately he sends in the sickle, because the harvest has come."
en.B: And when the grain is ready, he puts in the sickle at once, because harvest time has come."
en.R: When the grain is ripe, the man goes right away and cuts it, because it is time to gather the harvest."

vi.L: Nhưng khi trái đã chín, lập tức người ấy đưa lưỡi liềm vào, vì mùa gặt đã đến."
vi.B: Khi hạt đã chín, người ấy liền đem liềm ra gặt, vì mùa gặt đã đến."
vi.R: Khi hạt đã chín, người ấy liền đi cắt về, vì đã đến lúc thu hoạch."

ko.L: 열매가 [거둘 수 있게] 되면, 그는 곧 낫을 댄다. 추수 때가 왔기 때문이다."
ko.B: 곡식이 익으면, 그는 곧바로 낫을 댄다. 추수할 때가 되었기 때문이다."
ko.R: 곡식이 다 익으면, 그 사람은 바로 가서 낫으로 곡식을 벤다. 거두어들일 때가 되었기 때문이다."

es.L: Y cuando el fruto lo permite, enseguida mete la hoz, porque ha llegado la siega».
es.B: Y cuando el grano está listo, enseguida le mete la hoz, porque ha llegado el tiempo de la cosecha».
es.R: Cuando el grano está maduro, el hombre va enseguida a cortarlo, porque ya es tiempo de recoger la cosecha».

fr.L: Et quand le fruit le permet, aussitôt il envoie la faucille, parce que la moisson est là. »
fr.B: Et dès que le grain est mûr, il y met aussitôt la faucille, car le temps de la moisson est arrivé. »
fr.R: Quand le grain est mûr, l’homme va tout de suite le couper, parce que c’est le moment de faire la moisson. »

sw.L: Lakini matunda yanaporuhusu, mara anapeleka mundu, kwa sababu mavuno yamefika."
sw.B: Na nafaka ikiisha kukomaa, mara moja anatia mundu, kwa sababu wakati wa mavuno umefika."
sw.R: Nafaka ikiiva, mtu yule anakwenda mara moja kuivuna, kwa sababu ni wakati wa mavuno."

decisions.choice: permits: when the crop is ready
decisions.reason: The fruit "allows" the harvest when it is ripe.

decisions.choice: he sends the sickle, the harvest has come: Joel 3:13
decisions.reason: Joel pictures God's judgment as a harvest: "Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe." The harvest is the end, when God gathers in his kingdom.

decisions.choice: the man goes and cuts it
decisions.reason: Readable says what sending the sickle means.

decisions.choice: "khi trái đã chín" (when the fruit permits)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot say that a crop "permits"; Literal says what the meaning decision says the idiom means, keeping "trái" (fruit).

decisions.choice: 열매가 [거둘 수 있게] 되면
decisions.reason: The Greek says "when the fruit permits"; Korean cannot say that of a crop, so Literal brackets what it permits.

decisions.choice: mete la hoz
decisions.reason: "Meter la hoz" is the Spanish phrase for starting to reap, and keeps the words of Joel 3:13 (meaning decision m2).

source.text: Καὶ ἔλεγεν· Πῶς ὁμοιώσωμεν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, ἢ ἐν τίνι αὐτὴν παραβολῇ θῶμεν;

records.literal_gloss: And he was saying, How shall we compare the kingdom of the God, or in what it parable shall we put?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was saying, "How shall we compare the kingdom of God, or by what parable shall we present it?
en.B: He also said, "What shall we liken the kingdom of God to? What parable shall we set beside it?
en.R: Jesus also said, "What is the kingdom of God like? What story can we use to picture it?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Chúng ta sẽ ví vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời với gì, hay dùng ngụ ngôn nào để trình bày vương quốc ấy?
vi.B: Ngài cũng nói: "Chúng ta sẽ so sánh vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời với điều gì? Chúng ta sẽ dùng ngụ ngôn nào để mô tả vương quốc ấy?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cũng nói: "Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời giống như điều gì? Chúng ta có thể dùng câu chuyện nào để hình dung vương quốc ấy?

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라를 우리가 무엇에 견줄까? 또는 어떤 비유로 그것을 나타낼까?
ko.B: 또 말씀하셨다. "우리가 하나님의 나라를 무엇에 견줄까? 어떤 비유로 그것을 설명할까?
ko.R: 예수께서 또 말씀하셨다. "하나님의 나라는 무엇과 같을까? 우리가 어떤 비유로 그것을 보여 줄 수 있을까?

es.L: Y decía: «¿Cómo compararemos el reino de Dios, o con qué parábola lo presentaremos?
es.B: También dijo: «¿Con qué compararemos el reino de Dios? ¿Qué parábola usaremos para describirlo?
es.R: Jesús también dijo: «¿Cómo es el reino de Dios? ¿Qué historia podemos usar para explicarlo?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait : « Comment comparerons-nous le royaume de Dieu, ou dans quelle parabole le mettrons-nous ?
fr.B: Il dit encore : « À quoi pourrions-nous comparer le royaume de Dieu ? Quelle parabole allons-nous en donner ?
fr.R: Jésus a dit aussi : « À quoi ressemble le royaume de Dieu ? Quelle histoire pouvons-nous raconter pour le faire comprendre ?

sw.L: Naye alikuwa akisema, "Tuufananisheje ufalme wa Mungu, au tuuweke katika mfano gani?
sw.B: Akasema pia, "Tuufananishe ufalme wa Mungu na nini? Tutumie mfano gani kuueleza?
sw.R: Yesu akasema pia, "Ufalme wa Mungu ni kama nini? Tutumie mfano gani kuuonyesha?

decisions.choice: shall we: Jesus draws the hearers into the search
decisions.reason: A teacher's way of asking the listeners to think with him.

decisions.choice: put: set out, present
decisions.reason: The verb means to set a picture before the hearers.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" for "we"
decisions.reason: "Chúng ta" includes the hearers, as Jesus draws them into the search (the meaning decision); "chúng tôi" would shut them out.

source.text: ὡς κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃς ὅταν σπαρῇ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, μικρότερον ὂν πάντων τῶν σπερμάτων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὅταν σπαρῇ, ἀναβαίνει καὶ γίνεται μεῖζον πάντων τῶν λαχάνων καὶ ποιεῖ κλάδους μεγάλους, ὥστε δύνασθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σκιὰν αὐτοῦ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνοῦν.

records.literal_gloss: As a grain of mustard, which when it is sown upon the earth, smaller being of all the seeds that [are] upon the earth, \v 32 and when it is sown, it grows up and becomes greater than all the garden plants and makes branches great, so that able to be under the shade of it the birds of the sky to nest.

en.L: [It is] like a grain of mustard, which, when it is sown on the ground, is smaller than all the seeds that are on the earth, \v 32 and when it is sown, it grows up and becomes greater than all the garden plants and makes great branches, so that the birds of the sky are able to nest under its shade."
en.B: It is like a mustard seed. When it is sown in the ground, it is smaller than every other seed on earth. \v 32 But once it is sown, it shoots up and becomes bigger than all the garden plants. It sends out branches so large that the birds of the sky can settle in its shade."
en.R: It is like a mustard seed. It is the smallest seed a farmer plants. \v 32 But after it is planted, it grows bigger than all the other plants in the garden. Its branches grow so big that birds can come and make their nests in its shade."

vi.L: [Vương quốc ấy] giống như một hạt cải, là hạt khi được gieo xuống đất thì nhỏ hơn tất cả các hạt giống trên đất, \v 32 nhưng khi đã được gieo, nó mọc lên và trở nên lớn hơn mọi thứ rau, và đâm những cành lớn, đến nỗi chim trời có thể làm tổ dưới bóng nó."
vi.B: Vương quốc ấy giống như một hạt cải. Khi được gieo xuống đất, hạt ấy nhỏ hơn mọi hạt giống trên đất. \v 32 Nhưng một khi đã được gieo, nó mọc vọt lên, trở nên lớn hơn mọi cây rau trong vườn. Nó đâm ra những cành lớn, đến nỗi chim trời có thể đến trú dưới bóng nó."
vi.R: Vương quốc ấy giống như một hạt cải. Đó là hạt nhỏ nhất mà nhà nông gieo trồng. \v 32 Nhưng sau khi được gieo, nó lớn lên, cao hơn tất cả các cây khác trong vườn. Cành của nó lớn đến nỗi chim chóc có thể đến làm tổ dưới bóng nó."

ko.L: 겨자씨 한 알과 같다. 그것은 땅에 뿌려질 때에는 땅 위에 있는 모든 씨보다 작지만, \v 32 뿌려지고 나면 자라 올라 모든 채소보다 커지고, 큰 가지들을 뻗어서, 하늘의 새들이 그 그늘 아래 깃들 수 있게 된다."
ko.B: 그것은 겨자씨와 같다. 겨자씨는 땅에 뿌릴 때에는 세상의 어떤 씨보다도 작다. \v 32 그러나 뿌리고 나면 자라서 어떤 밭 채소보다도 커지고, 큰 가지를 뻗어서 하늘의 새들이 그 그늘에 깃들 만큼 된다."
ko.R: 하나님의 나라는 겨자씨와 같다. 겨자씨는 농부가 심는 씨 가운데 가장 작은 씨다. \v 32 그러나 심고 나면, 밭에 있는 다른 어떤 식물보다 크게 자란다. 가지들이 아주 크게 자라서, 새들이 와서 그 그늘에 둥지를 틀 수 있다."

es.L: [Es] como un grano de mostaza, que, cuando se siembra en la tierra, es más pequeño que todas las semillas que hay en la tierra, \v 32 y cuando se siembra, crece y llega a ser mayor que todas las hortalizas, y echa ramas grandes, de modo que las aves del cielo pueden anidar bajo su sombra».
es.B: Es como una semilla de mostaza. Cuando se siembra en la tierra, es más pequeña que todas las demás semillas del mundo. \v 32 Pero una vez sembrada, crece y se hace más grande que todas las plantas del huerto. Echa ramas tan grandes que las aves del cielo pueden cobijarse bajo su sombra».
es.R: Es como una semilla de mostaza. Es la semilla más pequeña que siembra un campesino. \v 32 Pero cuando se siembra, crece más que todas las otras plantas del huerto. Sus ramas se hacen tan grandes que los pájaros pueden venir y hacer sus nidos bajo su sombra».

fr.L: [Il est] comme un grain de moutarde qui, lorsqu’il est semé sur la terre, est plus petit que toutes les semences qui sont sur la terre, \v 32 et, lorsqu’il est semé, il monte et devient plus grand que toutes les plantes potagères, et il fait de grandes branches, si bien que les oiseaux du ciel peuvent nicher sous son ombre. »
fr.B: Il est comme une graine de moutarde. Quand on la sème en terre, elle est plus petite que toutes les autres graines de la terre. \v 32 Mais une fois semée, elle pousse et devient plus grande que toutes les plantes du potager. Elle étend des branches si grandes que les oiseaux du ciel peuvent s’abriter à son ombre. »
fr.R: Il est comme une graine de moutarde. C’est la plus petite graine que l’on sème. \v 32 Mais une fois semée, elle grandit plus que toutes les autres plantes du jardin. Ses branches deviennent si grandes que les oiseaux peuvent venir faire leur nid à son ombre. »

sw.L: [Ni] kama punje ya haradali, ambayo inapopandwa ardhini, ni ndogo kuliko mbegu zote zilizo duniani, \v 32 na inapopandwa, hukua na kuwa kubwa kuliko mboga zote, na hutoa matawi makubwa, hata ndege wa angani wanaweza kufanya makao chini ya kivuli chake."
sw.B: Ni kama mbegu ya haradali. Inapopandwa ardhini, ni ndogo kuliko mbegu nyingine zote duniani. \v 32 Lakini ikishapandwa, inakua na kuwa kubwa kuliko mimea yote ya bustanini. Inatoa matawi makubwa, hata ndege wa angani wanaweza kukaa katika kivuli chake."
sw.R: Ni kama mbegu ya haradali. Hiyo ndiyo mbegu ndogo kuliko zote ambazo mkulima hupanda. \v 32 Lakini ikishapandwa, inakua kuliko mimea mingine yote ya bustanini. Matawi yake yanakuwa makubwa sana, hata ndege wanaweza kuja na kujenga viota vyao katika kivuli chake."

decisions.choice: smaller than all the seeds: the smallest seed people knew to sow
alternatives: the smallest seed in the whole world
decisions.reason: The mustard seed was proverbially tiny (Matthew 17:20). Jesus speaks of what his hearers sowed, not of all plants.

decisions.choice: mustard: a garden plant that grows taller than a man in a season
decisions.reason: Black mustard grew in Galilee and could reach several feet high, large enough for birds to sit in.

decisions.choice: birds nesting in its shade: a great kingdom that shelters many
decisions.reason: The prophets use this picture of a great kingdom (Ezekiel 17:23; 31:6; Daniel 4:12). Some see the nations coming in; Mark does not say.

decisions.choice: the sky: the air above the earth
decisions.reason: The word means heaven or sky; birds of the sky are wild birds.

decisions.choice: split into several sentences
decisions.reason: The Greek sentence repeats "when it is sown" and runs on. Balanced and Readable break it up.

decisions.choice: make their nests
decisions.reason: The verb means to settle or live in a shelter. Readable uses the simplest picture.

decisions.choice: "hạt cải" for the mustard seed
decisions.reason: "Hạt cải" is the seed of the mustard plant and the word Vietnamese Bible readers know; "mù tạt" names the condiment.

decisions.choice: "[Vương quốc ấy]"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a subject before "giống như"; Literal brackets it and names the kingdom, since "nó" would point to the parable.

decisions.choice: "깃들다" (L, B); "둥지를 틀다" (R)
decisions.reason: "깃들다" is the natural Korean word for birds settling and nesting; Readable uses the plainer "둥지를 틀다".

decisions.choice: anidar (L); cobijarse (B); hacer sus nidos (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to settle or nest (meaning decision m3); Balanced stresses the shelter the great plant gives.

decisions.choice: un grain de moutarde (L); une graine de moutarde (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "grain", closest to the Greek word; Balanced and Readable say "graine", the everyday French word for a seed.

source.text: Καὶ τοιαύταις παραβολαῖς πολλαῖς ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον, καθὼς ἠδύναντο ἀκούειν·

records.literal_gloss: And with such parables many he was speaking to them the word, as they were able to hear;

en.L: And with many such parables {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was speaking the word to them, as they were able to hear;
en.B: With many parables like these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke the word to them, as much as they were able to hear.
en.R: Jesus used many stories like these to teach people God's message. He taught them as much as they could understand.

vi.L: Và bằng nhiều ngụ ngôn như thế, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giảng lời cho họ, tùy theo sức họ có thể nghe;
vi.B: Ngài dùng nhiều ngụ ngôn như thế để giảng lời cho họ, tùy theo sức họ có thể nghe được.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu dùng nhiều câu chuyện như thế để dạy dân chúng sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài dạy họ nhiều đến mức họ có thể hiểu được.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 이와 같은 많은 비유로, 그들이 들을 수 있는 만큼 그들에게 말씀을 하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 이와 같은 많은 비유로, 그들이 알아들을 수 있는 만큼 말씀을 전하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 이런 비유를 많이 들어서 사람들에게 하나님의 말씀을 가르치셨다. 그들이 알아들을 수 있는 만큼 가르치셨다.

es.L: Y con muchas parábolas como estas les hablaba la palabra, conforme podían oír;
es.B: Con muchas parábolas como estas les anunciaba la palabra, en la medida en que podían escucharla.
es.R: Jesús usaba muchas historias como estas para enseñar a la gente el mensaje de Dios. Les enseñaba tanto como podían entender.

fr.L: Et par beaucoup de paraboles semblables, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur annonçait la parole, selon qu’ils pouvaient entendre ;
fr.B: C’est par beaucoup de paraboles de ce genre qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur annonçait la parole, dans la mesure où ils pouvaient l’entendre.
fr.R: Jésus a raconté beaucoup d’histoires comme celles-là pour enseigner aux gens le message de Dieu. Il leur enseignait autant qu’ils pouvaient comprendre.

sw.L: Na kwa mifano mingi ya namna hiyo alikuwa akiwaambia neno, kadiri walivyoweza kusikia;
sw.B: Kwa mifano mingi kama hiyo aliwaambia neno, kwa kadiri walivyoweza kusikia.
sw.R: Yesu alitumia mifano mingi kama hiyo kuwafundisha watu ujumbe wa Mungu. Aliwafundisha kadiri walivyoweza kuelewa.

decisions.choice: as they were able to hear: as much as they could take in
alternatives: in a way that hid the meaning from them
decisions.reason: Jesus fitted his teaching to his hearers. The verse balances 4:11-12.

decisions.choice: the word: the message of God's kingdom
decisions.reason: As in 4:14.

decisions.choice: God's message
decisions.reason: As in 4:14.

source.text: χωρὶς δὲ παραβολῆς οὐκ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς, κατ’ ἰδίαν δὲ τοῖς ἰδίοις μαθηταῖς ἐπέλυεν πάντα.

records.literal_gloss: without but parable not he was speaking to them, privately but to the own disciples he was explaining all things.

en.L: and without a parable {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not speak to them, but privately {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} explained everything to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own disciples.
en.B: He would say nothing to them without a parable, but in private {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made everything plain to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own disciples.
en.R: He always used stories when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} taught the crowds. But when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was alone with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them what everything meant.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không nói với họ điều gì mà không dùng ngụ ngôn, nhưng khi ở riêng, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải thích mọi điều cho các môn đồ của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài không nói với họ điều gì mà không dùng ngụ ngôn, nhưng khi ở riêng, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải thích rõ mọi điều cho các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi dạy dân chúng, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn kể chuyện. Nhưng khi ở riêng với các môn đồ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải thích cho họ ý nghĩa của mọi điều.

ko.L: 그리고 비유 없이는 그들에게 말씀하지 않으셨다. 그러나 따로 계실 때에는 자기 제자들에게 모든 것을 풀이해 주셨다.
ko.B: 비유를 들지 않고는 그들에게 아무것도 말씀하지 않으셨고, 제자들과 따로 계실 때에는 모든 것을 풀어 설명해 주셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 무리를 가르치실 때 언제나 비유를 들어 말씀하셨다. 그러나 제자들하고만 계실 때에는 모든 것이 무슨 뜻인지 설명해 주셨다.

es.L: y sin parábola no les hablaba, pero en privado a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propios discípulos les explicaba todo.
es.B: No les decía nada sin usar parábolas, pero en privado les explicaba todo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propios discípulos.
es.R: Siempre usaba historias cuando enseñaba a la multitud. Pero cuando estaba a solas con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, les explicaba lo que significaba todo.

fr.L: et sans parabole {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne leur parlait pas, mais, en particulier, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} expliquait tout à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres disciples.
fr.B: Il ne leur disait rien sans parabole, mais en privé {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} expliquait tout à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait les foules, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} utilisait toujours des histoires. Mais quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était seul avec {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur expliquait ce que tout cela voulait dire.

sw.L: na pasipo mfano hakuwa akisema nao; lakini faraghani aliwafafanulia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wenyewe mambo yote.
sw.B: Hakusema nao neno lolote bila mfano, lakini faraghani aliwafafanulia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wenyewe kila kitu.
sw.R: Kila mara alipofundisha umati alitumia mifano. Lakini alipokuwa peke {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, aliwaeleza maana ya kila kitu.

decisions.choice: explained: untied, solved
decisions.reason: The verb means to loosen or solve, as one solves a riddle.

decisions.choice: was speaking, was explaining: this was his habit
decisions.reason: The verbs describe what he did again and again.

decisions.choice: the crowds
decisions.reason: Readable names who "them" are.

decisions.choice: "제자들" at Readable
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "제자들" at every level; the word is plain in Korean, so Readable does not follow the English "followers" (also 4:35-41).

decisions.choice: discípulos at every level
decisions.reason: As in 2:14: Readable keeps "discípulos", an everyday Spanish word, where the English Readable says "followers". The same in 4:35 and 4:40.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi wake wenyewe (his own disciples)
decisions.reason: "Wenyewe" agrees with "wanafunzi" and so means "his own disciples", as the Greek does; "mwenyewe" would agree with Jesus and mean "he himself explained".

source.text: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὀψίας γενομένης· Διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πέραν.

records.literal_gloss: And he says to them on that the day, evening having come, Let us go across to the other side.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to them on that day, when evening had come, "Let us go across to the other side."
en.B: As evening came on that day, Jesus said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples, "Let us go across to the far side of the lake."
en.R: That evening Jesus said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers, "Let us go across to the other side of the lake."

vi.L: Và vào ngày ấy, khi chiều đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Chúng ta hãy sang bờ bên kia."
vi.B: Chiều tối hôm ấy, Đức Giê-xu nói với các môn đồ: "Chúng ta hãy qua bờ hồ bên kia."
vi.R: Chiều hôm ấy, Đức Giê-xu nói với các môn đồ: "Chúng ta hãy đi qua bên kia hồ."

ko.L: 그리고 그날 저녁이 되었을 때에 그분이 그들에게 말씀하신다. "건너편으로 건너가자."
ko.B: 그날 저녁이 되자, 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "바다 건너편으로 건너가자."
ko.R: 그날 저녁에 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "호수 건너편으로 가자."

es.L: Y les dice aquel día, al caer la tarde: «Pasemos al otro lado».
es.B: Al atardecer de aquel día, Jesús les dijo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «Crucemos a la otra orilla del lago».
es.R: Esa tarde, Jesús les dijo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «Vamos al otro lado del lago».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit, ce jour-là, le soir étant venu : « Passons sur l’autre rive. »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, le soir venu, Jésus dit à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « Passons sur l’autre rive. »
fr.R: Ce soir-là, Jésus a dit à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « Allons de l’autre côté du lac. »

sw.L: Naye anawaambia siku ile, jioni ilipofika, "Tuvuke twende ng'ambo."
sw.B: Siku hiyo jioni ilipokaribia, Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, "Tuvuke twende upande wa pili wa ziwa."
sw.R: Jioni ya siku ile Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, "Tuvuke twende upande wa pili wa ziwa."

decisions.choice: says: present tense telling a past event
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: the other side: the eastern shore of the lake
decisions.reason: The east side was largely Gentile country; they land in the region of the Gerasenes (5:1).

decisions.choice: his disciples/followers; of the lake
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "them" are and what they are crossing.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos; del lago
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable say whom Jesus spoke to and which side is meant (meaning decision m2).

source.text: καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν ὄχλον παραλαμβάνουσιν αὐτὸν ὡς ἦν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ, καὶ ἄλλα πλοῖα ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And having left the crowd, they take along him as he was in the boat, and other boats were with him.

en.L: And leaving the crowd, they take {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} along, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was, in the boat; and other boats were with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: They sent the crowd away and took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} along in the boat, since {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was already in it. Other boats also went with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: The followers left the crowd. Jesus was already in the boat, so they took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with them. Some other boats went along too.

vi.L: Và rời đám đông, họ đem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} theo, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ở trong thuyền; và có những thuyền khác cùng đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Họ để đám đông ở lại và đưa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi trong chiếc thuyền {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ngồi sẵn. Cũng có những thuyền khác đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Các môn đồ rời đám đông. Đức Giê-xu đã ở sẵn trong thuyền, nên họ đưa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi luôn. Cũng có mấy chiếc thuyền khác đi theo.

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 무리를 남겨 두고, 그분이 배에 계신 그대로 그분을 모시고 간다. 그리고 다른 배들도 그분과 함께 있었다.
ko.B: 제자들은 무리를 남겨 두고, 이미 배에 타고 계신 예수를 그대로 모시고 떠났다. 다른 배들도 함께 갔다.
ko.R: 제자들은 무리를 남겨 두고 떠났다. 예수께서는 벌써 배에 타고 계셨기 때문에, 제자들은 예수를 모시고 그대로 떠났다. 다른 배들도 함께 따라갔다.

es.L: Y dejando a la multitud, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} toman consigo, así como estaba, en la barca; y otras barcas estaban con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Despidieron a la multitud y se {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaron en la barca, pues ya estaba en ella. Otras barcas también {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} acompañaban.
es.R: Los discípulos dejaron a la multitud. Jesús ya estaba en la barca, así que se {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaron con ellos. También iban otras barcas.

fr.L: Et, laissant la foule, ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmènent, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était, dans la barque ; et d’autres barques étaient avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Ils quittèrent la foule et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmenèrent dans la barque où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se trouvait déjà. D’autres barques {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accompagnaient.
fr.R: Les disciples ont laissé la foule. Jésus était déjà dans la barque, alors ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont emmené avec eux. D’autres barques sont venues aussi.

sw.L: Nao wakiisha kuuacha umati, wanamchukua kama alivyokuwa katika mashua; na mashua nyingine zilikuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.B: Wakauacha umati, wakamchukua pamoja nao katika mashua, kwa kuwa alikuwa tayari ndani yake. Mashua nyingine pia zilikwenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.R: Wanafunzi waliuacha umati. Yesu alikuwa tayari ndani ya mashua, kwa hiyo wakaondoka {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Mashua nyingine pia zilikwenda pamoja nao.

decisions.choice: as he was in the boat: he was already in the boat from 4:1
decisions.reason: They set off without going ashore first.

decisions.choice: take along: present tense telling a past event
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: other boats: others came with them
decisions.reason: Mark mentions them but says nothing more of them.

decisions.choice: since he was already in it (B); was already in the boat (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the meaning note.

decisions.choice: "모시고 가다" for taking Jesus along
decisions.reason: Korean marks the disciples' respect for Jesus in the verb itself; "데리고 가다" would treat him as someone under their charge.

decisions.choice: pues ya estaba en ella
decisions.reason: As in English: he was already in the boat from 4:1 (meaning decision m1).

source.text: καὶ γίνεται λαῖλαψ μεγάλη ἀνέμου, καὶ τὰ κύματα ἐπέβαλλεν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, ὥστε ἤδη γεμίζεσθαι τὸ πλοῖον.

records.literal_gloss: And comes a storm great of wind, and the waves were throwing into the boat, so that already was being filled the boat.

en.L: And a great windstorm comes up, and the waves were breaking into the boat, so that the boat was already filling.
en.B: A fierce windstorm blew up, and the waves were crashing into the boat, so that it was already filling with water.
en.R: Then a very strong wind began to blow. Big waves crashed into the boat. Soon the boat was starting to fill with water.

vi.L: Và một cơn bão gió lớn nổi lên, và sóng đánh vào thuyền, đến nỗi thuyền đã bắt đầu đầy nước.
vi.B: Một cơn bão lớn nổi lên, sóng đập vào thuyền, đến nỗi thuyền đã gần ngập nước.
vi.R: Rồi một trận gió rất mạnh nổi lên. Những đợt sóng lớn đánh vào thuyền. Chẳng bao lâu, nước bắt đầu tràn vào đầy thuyền.

ko.L: 그런데 큰 돌풍이 일어난다. 그리고 파도가 배 안으로 덮쳐 들어와서, 배가 벌써 [물로] 차고 있었다.
ko.B: 그런데 거센 돌풍이 일어나서, 파도가 배 안으로 덮쳐 들어오는 바람에 배에 물이 벌써 가득 차고 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 아주 센 바람이 불기 시작했다. 큰 파도가 배 안으로 쏟아져 들어왔다. 곧 배에 물이 차기 시작했다.

es.L: Y se levanta una gran tempestad de viento, y las olas se echaban dentro de la barca, de modo que la barca ya se estaba llenando.
es.B: Se desató una fuerte tormenta de viento, y las olas rompían sobre la barca, de modo que ya se estaba llenando de agua.
es.R: Entonces empezó a soplar un viento muy fuerte. Grandes olas golpeaban la barca. Pronto la barca empezó a llenarse de agua.

fr.L: Et il se lève une grande tempête de vent, et les vagues se jetaient dans la barque, si bien que déjà la barque se remplissait.
fr.B: Un violent coup de vent se leva, et les vagues se jetaient dans la barque, au point qu’elle se remplissait déjà d’eau.
fr.R: Alors un vent très fort s’est mis à souffler. De grosses vagues frappaient la barque. Bientôt, la barque a commencé à se remplir d’eau.

sw.L: Na inatokea dhoruba kubwa ya upepo, na mawimbi yalikuwa yakiingia ndani ya mashua, hata mashua ikawa tayari inajaa.
sw.B: Dhoruba kali ya upepo ikavuma, na mawimbi yakawa yakiipiga mashua na kuingia ndani, hata ikaanza kujaa maji.
sw.R: Kisha upepo mkali sana ulianza kuvuma. Mawimbi makubwa yakaipiga mashua, na maji yakaingia ndani. Mara mashua ilikuwa ikijaa maji.

decisions.choice: a great windstorm: a sudden squall on the lake
decisions.reason: The lake lies low among hills, and winds can sweep down on it without warning.

decisions.choice: comes: present tense telling a past event
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: already filling: the boat was in real danger
decisions.reason: The water was coming in faster than they could deal with.

decisions.choice: with water
decisions.reason: English needs to say what filled the boat.

decisions.choice: de agua
decisions.reason: As in English: says what the boat was filling with.

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἐν τῇ πρύμνῃ ἐπὶ τὸ προσκεφάλαιον καθεύδων· καὶ ἐγείρουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Διδάσκαλε, οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἀπολλύμεθα;

records.literal_gloss: And he was in the stern on the cushion sleeping. And they wake him and say to him, Teacher, not is it a concern to you that we are perishing?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. And they wake {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and say to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, is it not a concern to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} that we are perishing?"
en.B: Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} was asleep on the cushion at the back of the boat. They woke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and said, "Teacher, does it mean nothing to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} that we are going to die?"
en.R: Jesus was at the back of the boat, sleeping with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head on a cushion. The followers woke {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up. They said, "Teacher, do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not care that we are going to die?"

vi.L: Còn chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì ở phía đuôi thuyền, đang ngủ trên chiếc gối. Và họ đánh thức {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, Thầy không quan tâm việc chúng con đang chết sao?"
vi.B: Còn chính Đức Giê-xu thì đang ngủ, gối đầu trên chiếc gối ở phía sau thuyền. Các môn đồ đánh thức {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói: "Thưa Thầy, chúng con sắp chết mà Thầy chẳng lo gì sao?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đang ở phía sau thuyền, gối đầu lên một chiếc gối mà ngủ. Các môn đồ đánh thức {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dậy. Họ nói: "Thưa Thầy, chúng con sắp chết rồi! Thầy không quan tâm sao?"

ko.L: 그런데 그분은 고물에서 베개를 베고 주무시고 계셨다. 그들이 그분을 깨우며 그분께 말한다. "선생님, 우리가 죽게 되었는데도 상관하지 않으십니까?"
ko.B: 예수께서는 배 뒤쪽에서 베개를 베고 주무시고 계셨다. 제자들이 예수를 깨우며 말했다. "선생님, 우리가 죽게 되었는데 아무렇지도 않으십니까?"
ko.R: 예수께서는 배 뒤쪽에서 베개를 베고 주무시고 계셨다. 제자들이 예수를 깨웠다. 그리고 말했다. "선생님, 우리가 다 죽게 생겼는데 걱정도 안 되십니까?"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba en la popa, durmiendo sobre el cabezal; y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} despiertan y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dicen: «Maestro, ¿no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} importa que perezcamos?».
es.B: Jesús, en cambio, estaba dormido sobre el cojín en la parte de atrás de la barca. Lo despertaron y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Maestro, ¿no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} importa que nos muramos?».
es.R: Jesús estaba en la parte de atrás de la barca, durmiendo con la cabeza sobre un cojín. Los discípulos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} despertaron y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Maestro, ¿no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} importa que nos vamos a morir?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était à la poupe, dormant sur le coussin. Et ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} réveillent et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disent : « Maître, cela ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}importe pas que nous périssions ? »
fr.B: Jésus, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, dormait à l’arrière de la barque, sur le coussin. Ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} réveillèrent et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Maître, cela ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fait rien que nous allions mourir ? »
fr.R: Jésus était à l’arrière de la barque. Il dormait, la tête sur un coussin. Les disciples {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont réveillé. Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « Maître, est-ce que cela {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}est égal que nous allions mourir ? »

sw.L: Naye {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alikuwa katika shetri, amelala juu ya mto; nao wanamwamsha na kumwambia, "Mwalimu, je, hujali kwamba tunaangamia?"
sw.B: Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alikuwa amelala nyuma ya mashua, kichwa juu ya mto. Wakamwamsha, wakamwambia, "Mwalimu, hujali kwamba tunakufa?"
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa nyuma ya mashua, amelala na kichwa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} juu ya mto. Wanafunzi wakamwamsha. Wakasema, "Mwalimu, hujali kwamba tunakaribia kufa?"

decisions.choice: he himself: Jesus set against the frightened disciples
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stressed. While they struggle, he sleeps.

decisions.choice: the stern, the cushion: the raised back of the boat and the cushion kept there
decisions.reason: The article points to the boat's own cushion, perhaps one used by the helmsman or a sandbag for ballast.

decisions.choice: we are perishing: we are about to die
decisions.reason: The verb means to be destroyed. They fear drowning.

decisions.choice: is it not a concern to you: a question of reproach
decisions.reason: The disciples ask as if he did not care. The form expects the answer "yes, I care".

decisions.choice: at the back of the boat
decisions.reason: "Stern" is a sailor's word. Balanced and Readable describe the place.

decisions.choice: with his head on
decisions.reason: Readable pictures how the cushion was used.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Thầy" and "Thầy" for "you", with no deity_pronoun span; "chúng con" for "we"
decisions.reason: The disciples speak to their teacher as "Thầy" and of themselves as "chúng con", the forms the style guide sets. "Thầy" is a noun of address and takes no span where the English "you" has one.

decisions.choice: The disciples speak in 합쇼체; "선생님" for "Teacher", with no pronoun for "you"
decisions.reason: Disciples speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 (style guide, section 4); Korean leaves the "you" unsaid after the title, and the honorific -시- in "않으십니까" carries it. "선생님" renders their word for teacher, not "주님" (Lord).

decisions.choice: "고물" (L); "배 뒤쪽" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "고물" is the Korean word for a ship's stern; Balanced and Readable say where it is for readers who do not know it.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} (L); Jesús, en cambio (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek stresses "he himself", set against the frightened disciples (meaning decision m1); Spanish shows the contrast with the written pronoun or "en cambio".

decisions.choice: Maestro
decisions.reason: The ordinary address to a teacher, as in John 13:13-14.

decisions.choice: Maître
decisions.reason: The address means "Teacher"; "Maître" is the French word for a teacher of disciples, the one John 1:38 uses to translate "Rabbi".

decisions.choice: Et lui, il était (L); Jésus, lui (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek stresses "he himself", set against the frightened disciples (meaning decision m1); French marks the stress with the detached pronoun "lui" before the subject.

decisions.choice: shetri (stern) and mto (cushion) at Literal; nyuma ya mashua at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: "Shetri" is the sailors' word for the stern; Balanced and Readable say "the back of the boat". "Mto" is a pillow or cushion here, not a river, which the context of sleeping makes clear.

source.text: καὶ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θαλάσσῃ· Σιώπα, πεφίμωσο.

records.literal_gloss: And having been woken he rebuked the wind and said to the sea, Be silent, be muzzled.

en.L: And being woken, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rebuked the wind and said to the sea, "Be silent! Be muzzled!"
en.B: Jesus woke, rebuked the wind, and commanded the sea, "Silence! Be still!"
en.R: Jesus woke up and gave the wind a strong command. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to the lake, "Be quiet! Be still!"

vi.L: Và thức dậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở gió và nói với biển: "Hãy im đi! Hãy câm miệng!"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu thức dậy, quở gió và truyền lệnh cho biển: "Im đi! Hãy lặng yên!"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu thức dậy và nghiêm khắc ra lệnh cho gió. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với mặt hồ: "Im đi! Hãy yên lặng!"

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 깨어 일어나셔서 바람을 꾸짖으시고 바다에게 말씀하셨다. "조용히 하여라! 입을 다물어라!"
ko.B: 예수께서 일어나셔서 바람을 꾸짖으시고 바다를 향해 명령하셨다. "조용히 하여라! 잠잠하여라!"
ko.R: 예수께서 일어나셔서 바람을 엄하게 꾸짖으셨다. 그리고 호수에게 말씀하셨다. "조용히 해라! 잠잠해라!"

es.L: Y despertándose, reprendió al viento y dijo al mar: «¡Calla! ¡Enmudece!».
es.B: Jesús se despertó, reprendió al viento y le ordenó al mar: «¡Silencio! ¡Cálmate!».
es.R: Jesús se despertó y le dio una orden firme al viento. Luego le dijo al lago: «¡Calla! ¡Quédate quieto!».

fr.L: Et, s’étant réveillé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} réprimanda le vent et dit à la mer : « Tais-toi ! Sois muselée ! »
fr.B: Jésus se réveilla, réprimanda le vent et ordonna à la mer : « Silence ! Calme-toi ! »
fr.R: Jésus s’est réveillé et il a donné un ordre sévère au vent. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit au lac : « Tais-toi ! Calme-toi ! »

sw.L: Naye akiisha kuamka, akaukemea upepo, akaiambia bahari, "Nyamaza! Fumba kinywa!"
sw.B: Yesu akaamka, akaukemea upepo, akaliamuru ziwa, "Nyamaza! Tulia!"
sw.R: Yesu aliamka, akaupa upepo amri kali. Kisha akaliambia ziwa, "Nyamaza! Tulia!"

decisions.choice: rebuked: gave a stern command
decisions.reason: The same verb is used when Jesus silences unclean spirits (1:25; 3:12).

decisions.choice: be muzzled: the word Jesus spoke to the unclean spirit (1:25)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the storm as to a hostile power. The form means "be still and stay so".

decisions.choice: Jesus commands wind and sea
alternatives: a lucky change in the weather
decisions.reason: In the Scriptures God stills the storm (Psalm 107:29) and sets limits to the sea (Job 38:8-11).

decisions.choice: Silence! Be still! (B); Be quiet! Be still! (R)
decisions.reason: "Muzzled" in English suggests an animal. Balanced and Readable give the sense; Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: gave the wind a strong command
decisions.reason: Readable says what "rebuke" means here.

decisions.choice: "Hãy câm miệng!" (L) for "be muzzled"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the hard picture of a mouth shut by force, the word spoken to the unclean spirit in 1:25 (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "lặng yên", "yên lặng", as is natural for wind and water.

decisions.choice: "입을 다물어라" (L); "잠잠하여라" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek is "be muzzled", the word Jesus spoke to the unclean spirit (1:25); Literal keeps a command to shut the mouth, while Balanced and Readable say "be still".

decisions.choice: ¡Enmudece!
decisions.reason: The word Jesus spoke to the unclean spirit in 1:25 (meaning decision m2), where Literal also says "enmudece".

decisions.choice: Sois muselée ! (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the muzzle, the word Jesus spoke to the unclean spirit in 1:25 (meaning decision m2); the participle agrees with "la mer". Balanced and Readable say "Calme-toi".

decisions.choice: Fumba kinywa! (shut your mouth) at Literal; Tulia! (be still) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Greek "be muzzled" is the word Jesus spoke to the unclean spirit (1:25) (m2). Literal keeps the picture of a closed mouth with "Fumba kinywa!"; Balanced and Readable say "Tulia!" (be still), as the English does. "Kukemea" (rebuke) is the verb used in 3:12.

source.text: καὶ ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος, καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.

records.literal_gloss: And ceased the wind, and there was a calm great.

en.L: And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
en.B: The wind dropped, and a great calm came over the water.
en.R: The wind stopped blowing, and the water became very calm.

vi.L: Và gió ngừng lại, và có một sự yên lặng lớn.
vi.B: Gió liền ngừng, và mặt nước trở nên lặng như tờ.
vi.R: Gió ngừng thổi, và mặt hồ trở nên rất êm.

ko.L: 그러자 바람이 그치고 큰 고요가 찾아왔다.
ko.B: 바람이 그치고 바다가 아주 잔잔해졌다.
ko.R: 바람이 멈추었다. 그리고 호수가 아주 잔잔해졌다.

es.L: Y cesó el viento, y hubo una gran calma.
es.B: El viento amainó, y sobrevino una gran calma.
es.R: El viento dejó de soplar, y el agua quedó muy tranquila.

fr.L: Et le vent tomba, et il se fit un grand calme.
fr.B: Le vent tomba, et un grand calme se fit sur l’eau.
fr.R: Le vent s’est arrêté de souffler, et l’eau est devenue toute calme.

sw.L: Na upepo ukakoma, kukawa shwari kuu.
sw.B: Upepo ukatulia, na shwari kuu ikaenea juu ya maji.
sw.R: Upepo ukaacha kuvuma, na maji yakawa shwari kabisa.

decisions.choice: a great calm: set against the great storm (4:37) and the great fear (4:41)
decisions.reason: Mark repeats "great" to show the change. The calm is as complete as the storm was fierce.

decisions.choice: came over the water
decisions.reason: Balanced says where the calm was.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τί δειλοί ἐστε;

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, Why fearful are you?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Why are you fearful?
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "Why are you so afraid?
en.R: Jesus said to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers, "Why are you so afraid?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao các con sợ hãi?
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Sao các con sợ đến thế?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với các môn đồ: "Sao các con sợ như vậy?

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "어찌하여 너희는 겁을 내느냐?
ko.B: 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 그렇게 겁을 내느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 그렇게 무서워하느냐?

es.L: Y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:son|sois}} miedosos?
es.B: Luego les preguntó: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} tanto miedo?
es.R: Jesús les dijo a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} tanto miedo?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Pourquoi êtes-vous craintifs ?
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur demanda : « Pourquoi avez-vous si peur ?
fr.R: Jésus a dit à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « Pourquoi avez-vous si peur ?

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Mbona ninyi ni waoga?
sw.B: Akawauliza, "Kwa nini mnaogopa hivyo?
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, "Kwa nini mnaogopa hivyo?

decisions.choice: fearful: timid, lacking courage
decisions.reason: The word means cowardly or timid, not reverent awe.

decisions.choice: why are you fearful: the SBLGNT has no "so"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "so". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: so
decisions.reason: "So" gives the tone of the question in natural English; it does not follow the added word in some manuscripts.

decisions.choice: tanto
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced and Readable add the force of the question; Literal follows the SBLGNT, which has no "so" (meaning decision m2).

source.text: οὔπω ἔχετε πίστιν;

records.literal_gloss: Not yet do you have faith?

en.L: Do you not yet have faith?"
en.B: Is there still no faith in you?"
en.R: Do you still not have faith in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"

vi.L: Các con chưa có đức tin sao?"
vi.B: Các con vẫn chưa có đức tin sao?"
vi.R: Các con vẫn chưa có đức tin nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao?"

ko.L: 아직도 믿음이 없느냐?"
ko.B: 아직도 너희에게 믿음이 없느냐?"
ko.R: 너희는 아직도 나를 믿는 믿음이 없느냐?"

es.L: ¿Todavía no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} fe?».
es.B: ¿Todavía no hay fe en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?».
es.R: ¿Todavía no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} fe en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}?».

fr.L: N’avez-vous pas encore de foi ? »
fr.B: Vous n’avez toujours pas de foi ? »
fr.R: Vous n’avez toujours pas foi en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ? »

sw.L: Bado hamna imani?"
sw.B: Je, hata sasa hamna imani?"
sw.R: Bado hamna imani {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}?"

decisions.choice: not yet: the SBLGNT reads "not yet"
alternatives: how is it that you have no faith
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "How is it that you have no faith?" The earliest read "Do you not yet have faith?" Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: faith: trust in Jesus and in God's power at work in him
decisions.reason: After all they have seen, they still do not trust him in danger.

decisions.choice: in me
decisions.reason: Readable says whom they should trust.

decisions.choice: "đức tin" for faith
decisions.reason: "Đức tin" is the key term for faith, as in the Vietnamese Colossians; "niềm tin" is kept for an ordinary belief.

decisions.choice: "믿음" at every level
decisions.reason: Faith is a key term and keeps one Korean word at every level; Readable adds "나를 믿는" for the English Readable's "in me".

decisions.choice: en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says in whom they should trust (meaning decision m2).

source.text: καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν, καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Τίς ἄρα οὗτός ἐστιν ὅτι καὶ ὁ ἄνεμος καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ὑπακούει αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: And they feared a fear great and were saying to one another, Who then this is, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

en.L: And they feared a great fear and were saying to one another, "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?"
en.B: Great fear came over them, and they kept saying to one another, "Who is this, then, that wind and sea alike obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?"
en.R: The followers were now terrified. They asked each other, "Who is this man? Even the wind and the water obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!"

vi.L: Và họ vô cùng kinh sợ, và nói với nhau: "Vậy người này là ai mà cả gió và biển cũng vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.B: Họ vô cùng kinh sợ và cứ nói với nhau: "Vậy người này là ai mà cả gió lẫn biển đều vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?"
vi.R: Các môn đồ vô cùng sợ hãi. Họ hỏi nhau: "Người này là ai vậy? Ngay cả gió và mặt hồ cũng vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!"

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 큰 두려움으로 두려워하며 서로 말하고 있었다. "그러면 이분이 누구이시기에 바람과 바다까지도 이분에게 순종하는가?"
ko.B: 그들은 몹시 두려워하며 서로 말했다. "이분이 도대체 누구이시기에 바람과 바다도 순종하는가?"
ko.R: 제자들은 이제 너무나 무서웠다. 그들은 서로 물었다. "이분은 도대체 어떤 분이신가? 바람과 호수까지도 이분의 말씀을 듣는구나!"

es.L: Y temieron con gran temor, y se decían unos a otros: «¿Quién, pues, es este, que aun el viento y el mar {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen?».
es.B: Se llenaron de un gran temor y se decían unos a otros: «¿Quién es este, entonces, que hasta el viento y el mar {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen?».
es.R: Los discípulos estaban aterrados. Se preguntaban unos a otros: «¿Quién es este hombre? ¡Hasta el viento y el agua {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen!».

fr.L: Et ils craignirent d’une grande crainte, et ils se disaient les uns aux autres : « Qui donc est celui-ci, pour que même le vent et la mer {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent ? »
fr.B: Ils furent saisis d’une grande crainte et se disaient les uns aux autres : « Qui est donc cet homme, pour que le vent et la mer eux-mêmes {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent ? »
fr.R: Les disciples étaient maintenant terrifiés. Ils se demandaient entre eux : « Qui est cet homme ? Même le vent et le lac {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent ! »

sw.L: Nao wakaingiwa na hofu kuu, wakawa wakiambiana, "Basi huyu ni nani, hata upepo na bahari vinamtii?"
sw.B: Hofu kuu ikawajaa, wakawa wakiambiana, "Huyu ni nani basi, hata upepo na ziwa vinamtii?"
sw.R: Wanafunzi waliogopa sana. Wakaulizana, "Mtu huyu ni nani? Hata upepo na maji vinamtii!"

decisions.choice: they feared a great fear: the awe of people before God's power
decisions.reason: The same words describe the sailors in Jonah 1:16 after God calmed the sea. Now they fear the one in the boat more than the storm.

decisions.choice: who then is this: only God rules wind and sea
decisions.reason: The question is left for the reader to answer from the Scriptures (Psalm 107:29) and from Mark's first line (1:1).

decisions.choice: were saying: they kept asking
decisions.reason: The verb describes ongoing talk.

decisions.choice: were now terrified
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the strength of the fear with a plain word.

decisions.choice: "vô cùng kinh sợ" for "they feared a great fear"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot repeat the noun after the verb without sounding broken; "kinh sợ" keeps the sense of awe the meaning decision gives, and "vô cùng" the "great".

decisions.choice: "người này" for "this one"; "{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}" for "him"
decisions.reason: The disciples ask who he is, so "người này" keeps the open question of the Greek; the pronoun that follows is the reverent "Ngài" under the setting, since the answer the story points to is that he does what only God does.

decisions.choice: The disciples speak among themselves in the plain style (-는가) but call Jesus "이분" with the honorific
decisions.reason: Equals speak to one another in 해라체 (style guide, section 4), but they speak of their teacher with respect; awe, not hostility, is the point of the question.

decisions.choice: temieron con gran temor
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek doubling of the verb and noun (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: ils craignirent d’une grande crainte (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek repetition of the verb and its noun, the awe of people before God’s power (meaning decision m1); "crainte" says awe better than "peur".
